title: Optimize button in photo tool makes images bigger
description: The optimize option is supposed to shrink pictures, but the output is 30 percent larger for every PNG we tried. Probably the wrong compression flag got passed in.

title: Pharmacy stock count wrong after a return
description: Returned boxes get added twice to the shelf quantity when the return is scanned from the second till. Monthly audit found 40 boxes that do not exist.

title: Quiz says I answered nothing but I answered everything
description: I completed all 25 questions and clicked finish, and the results page says 0 of 25 answered. My teacher sees zero as well. This is an exam grade, please fix urgently.

title: Overtime hours rounded down on night shifts
description: 7.5 overtime hours get stored as 7 on the timesheet when the employee works nights. Day shift entries keep their decimals, only the night rule does this.

title: Firmware updates are not signed
description: Device installs any image served from the update URL if the checksum matches. Someone on the same network could get access to every thermostat by pushing malicious firmware, a serious vulnerability.

title: Security camera clip downloads with wrong timestamp
description: Clip's file name and overlay show a time two hours before real event. Video content is fine, only time label is off, which is a problem for a police report we filed.

title: Docs site shows Python 2 print syntax
description: Several docs examples still use `print "hello"`, which fails on Python 3.

title: Calendar sync creates events in year 1970
description: Connecting clinic calendar to staff phones gives a flood of events dated 1 January 1970. Probably a seconds versus milliseconds mixup in ICS feed.

title: URL preview fetches internal addresses
description: Chat link preview will fetch http://169.254.169.254/ and show the response. That gives any account SSRF access to cloud metadata inside our network.

title: Drone returns home to wrong coordinates
description: Return-to-home uses the first GPS fix at power on rather than the takeoff fix. If you carry the drone 50 meters before launch it lands 50 meters away. Fw 1.2.8.

title: Permission check runs one query per row
description: Listing 500 documents means 500 permission queries and the page takes 15 seconds. Access rules are correct, nobody sees anything they shouldn't, but those lookups should be batched.

title: Autocomplete for medication names
description: Doctors type drug names from memory, with some variation. A suggestion list from our formulary, as they type, makes notes much cleaner.

title: CSV import reads 03/04 as March 4 for EU tenants
description: The locale setting is ignored by the parser, so European customers get months and days swapped on imported shipments. No warning at all, it just saves the wrong date.

title: Android app crashes when using camera for avatar
description: Profile, change picture, take a photo: the app dies as soon as you confirm the shot. Logcat shows FileUriExposedException. Gallery pick is fine, just the camera route fails on 8.1.0.

title: Cache keeps old price after sale ends
description: Product pages show sale price for hours after a campaign stops, and then cart uses real price. Nothing is slow here, invalidation simply never fires and customers feel cheated.

title: JWT with alg none is accepted
description: Tokens with alg none pass validation, I got admin access on my test account with a hand made token.

title: Security scan adds three hours to every pipeline
description: Dependency scan step downloads its database again in each job and merges wait for hours. Findings are fine, we just need that step to take minutes with a shared cache.

title: Cancel older pipeline runs on new push
description: Add an option to auto-cancel older runs when I push new commits to a branch.

title: Let customers see their rate limit usage
description: API customers keep emailing to ask how close they are to their hourly limit. A small usage meter in the developer dashboard would stop most of that.

title: OpenAPI client generation breaks on nullable enum
description: Generator produces uncompilable code for `priority` because spec says nullable and enum together with no null member. Hand fixing that file each release is getting old.

title: Why can everyone see my salary??
description: I just found out that any colleague with a login can open my pay data through the app, this is unacceptable! Who approved this? Fix the access rules today.

title: Webhook retries with backoff
description: Integrators ask for failed webhook deliveries to be retried a few times with growing delays. We also want to see the attempt history in the admin panel.

title: Door sensor reports open while door is closed
description: since OTA 3.1 the hub shows front door as open all night even tho the magnet is touching. reboot fixes it for maybe an hour. got 11 false alerts yesterday.

title: Slow API response on /reports/summary
description: Average 8 seconds, worst case 40 seconds, each aggregate is computed live per request.

title: Downloaded csv has a blank column at the start
description: every csv i download from reports now has an empty column as the very first one, so my import script reads everything shifted by one. was fine before the last release.

title: Load example button fills wrong fields
description: Load example button on import page puts dates into name column. Docs show how it should look, so it's this button that is broken.

title: Link to related help article in error dialogs
description: When something goes wrong the dialog could include a "learn more" link. Our support team would save time, and the articles already exist, they just are not connected to the app.

title: Example quizzes for new teachers
description: New teachers start with an empty course page. Offer a few example quizzes they can load and edit, that gets them going faster than any guide.

title: Manual screenshots show the old menu
description: All pictures in the cashier manual are outdated, they show the blue menu from before the redesign. Trainers have to explain that the buttons moved, so this section needs fresh screenshots.

title: Coupon says used but I never used it
description: Hello, I got the birthday coupon by mail and when I enter it the site says it is already used. This is my first order so that cannot be true, please help.

title: Flaky test fails only around midnight UTC
description: test_daily_rollup compares against date.today() while the fixture uses UTC, so the nightly build goes red between 00:00 and 02:00. Reruns pass, which is why nobody looked at it.

title: Password reset responds slower for real accounts
description: Reset requests take 900 ms when the account exists and 40 ms when not. Easy to measure, so an attacker can work out who is a customer of ours.

title: Memory card not detected after update
description: Trail camera firmware 4.0.2 says "no memory card" on 64 GB cards that worked before. 32 GB cards still work, so maybe the exFAT path broke.

title: Sample app in tutorial does not match the text
description: Tutorial tells you to edit `main.py` line 20, and in the example repo that line is blank. Seems these instructions were written against an older commit.

title: Image resize happens during the request
description: Upload request blocks 6 seconds while five sizes get created, users wait for nothing. Move it to a background job, latency is terrible at peak.

title: Would be nice if the app told us about planned downtime
description: When a release takes the system down for 10 minutes we only notice from errors. A status notice beforehand is what we are asking for, nothing else is wrong.

title: Load balancer page shows all nodes down
description: Status page says all nodes behind the load balancer are down, but traffic flows fine and latency is normal. The check reads a stale file.

title: Choose which fields go in the export
description: The export has 60 columns and I need 8. Please let me tick columns before downloading, and remember my selection for next time.

title: Load sample data for new tenants
description: New tenants see empty screens and have no idea where to start. Let them load sample data with one click and remove it again later.

title: Annotations on dashboard charts
description: We need a text marker on a chart date, something like campaign started.

title: Login troubleshooting page sends people in circles
description: Help page for login problems says "see the login troubleshooting page", which is itself. We need actual steps for forgotten password and locked account written there.

title: Parent can open another child's report
description: Our son's report is at /children/311/report. After login with another number I saw the marks of a child in a different class, please check access rights.

title: Kid mode for tablet
description: I would like a mode that limits my child to the learning games and locks settings and purchases behind a code. Other apps for kids offer this.

title: Payslip batch PDF generation is slow
description: 2000 payslips take most of a night since a new browser instance starts for each PDF. Rendering in one process with a page pool should take minutes, not hours.

title: Two factor login mail arrives with no code
description: Login mail for two factor has an empty body, the template variable is wrong. Nobody can access their account until support turns the setting off.

title: Report card prints Arabic names reversed
description: In the printed report card, names written in Arabic come out with the letters in reverse order. Screen view is correct, only the PDF template has this problem.

title: Refresh tokens are valid for ten years
description: Refresh tokens live ten years with no revocation, a stolen phone keeps access to the account.

title: Chart with a year of data takes 30 seconds
description: Selecting 12 months in the energy dashboard draws every reading as a point and the browser tab freezes for 30 seconds. Downsampling would make it load fast.

title: I am requesting a function for sending grades to parents
description: In our school we are writing each parent separately. If the system can send grades by message to all parents in one class, it will save many hours for teachers.

title: Password field clears itself while typing
description: On our hospital staff app a password box empties whenever an autofill suggestion pops up. Nurses need several tries to log in at start of a shift.

title: Chat notification when the nightly build fails
description: Nobody reads the failure mails any more. Posting a short line with a link to the team channel would get eyes on it sooner.

title: Architecture diagram in docs shows old services
description: Diagram in docs/architecture.md still has two services we retired last year.

title: Database failover runbook is outdated
description: Failover runbook page still names old replicas and a deleted script, needs a rewrite.

title: Onboarding wiki mentions a retired server
description: Wiki page for new developers says to connect to build-02, switched off in March. The rest of the page is probably outdated as well, somebody should go through it.

title: Crafted input makes the validator run for minutes
description: A 40 character string of repeated a's makes the email regex run for minutes at 100 percent CPU. Not normal slowness: an attacker can send a few of these with no login and stop the API.

title: npe in OrderMapper when coupon is null
description: NullPointerException at OrderMapper.toDto(OrderMapper.java:142) for orders without a coupon, since the 3.8.1 deploy.

title: Backup archive downloadable from web root
description: https://shop.example/backup.zip downloads the full site including config file secrets, with no login. Cleanup script leaves it there every night, exposed to anyone.

title: Error section of docs is cut off
description: Under Troubleshooting the docs page has a table of errors whose last column is cut off on all screen sizes. Content is what we want, somebody needs to fix the markup of that page.

title: Export feature creates file with wrong encoding
description: The feature we got last month exports names as garbage for anything outside basic Latin, since the file is written in cp1252. Please make it write UTF-8 like the screen shows it.

title: Support for left-handed controls
description: Feature request: please add an option to mirror the on-screen controls in the mobile game. I am left handed and my thumb always covers the map.

title: Timezone wrong on shift roster for remote staff
description: Staff in another time zone see their shift two hours off in the mobile roster while the web roster is right. Someone already missed a Monday morning shift.

title: App keeps saying no internet while I have internet
description: Wifi and mobile data both work, every other app is ok, yours shows the no connection page. If I wait some seconds it comes back, then it goes away again.

title: Crash reporter crashes on startup
description: The analytics and crash reporting module throws during init when the device is offline, taking the app down with it. Nothing gets reported, of course. Observed on 7.0.1.

title: Invoice URLs are sequential and open to anyone
description: /invoices/20261044.pdf opens with no login and you can walk through all numbers. Private data exposed: names, addresses, items. Should require login or a random token.

title: Dashboard should support custom date presets
description: Our fiscal year starts in April, so "this year" means nothing for us. Let admins define their own presets like "FY26 Q1".

title: Login with student ID number
description: Students forget the mail address they signed up with. Let them use their student ID at login as well, the password stays the same.

title: Video visits in clinic booking
description: Since last year many follow-ups can be done by video. We need an appointment type which sends a meeting link instead of a room number.

title: Leaderboard shows yesterday's top score as today
description: Daily leaderboard does not reset at midnight in some regions, people see yesterday's champion for up to 6 hours. Reset job uses a fixed UTC time.

title: Show last login time on profile page
description: Customers ask when they last used the service. A line such as "last login yesterday at 18:02" on the profile page would answer that without a support call.

title: Fingerprint login for the mobile app
description: Typing my password on the phone is annoying. Please add fingerprint login as an option, my other apps have this already.

title: Retry button on failed uploads
description: Please add a retry button next to a failed photo upload, picking it again is tedious.

title: Contributor guide should describe commit message style
description: Commit message style is written nowhere, add a short section to the contributor guide.

title: pagination returns same row on two pages
description: sorting by created_at with equal timestamps gives repeats across pages and some rows are never returned. need a tie breaker on id in the ORDER BY.

title: Loading screen lasts 90 seconds on console
description: Every fast travel means a 90 second loading screen on base hardware. Textures for the full map seem to load each time, not just the region.

title: Inline help for tax field is misleading
description: Help page for the invoice form says "enter tax in percent" while the field expects an amount. Field does what it should, but this section of the docs is wrong and new staff get confused.

title: Encryption key hard coded in firmware
description: AES key for local traffic is the same in every unit and can be read from the firmware image with `strings`. One opened device exposes all of them, this is a security vulnerability.

title: Auto-reply when clinic is closed
description: Messages sent to the clinic at night get no answer until morning. An automatic reply with opening hours and the emergency number would set the right expectations.

title: It would be helpful to add alt text for images
description: Teachers with blind students need to describe pictures in their course pages. A field for a text description on each upload would make it possible.

title: CSV import for students
description: At the start of the year we type in 600 students by hand. Our registrar has a spreadsheet with all the data, please let us upload it.

title: Job filter shows candidates from previous opening
description: Switching the recruiter view from one job to another keeps the old candidate list until a manual refresh. Two people got rejection notes meant for a different role because of it.

title: printing a label prints two blank ones first
description: steps to reproduce: pick any parcel, press print label. printer feeds two blank labels and then the correct one. wasting a roll a day, v2.3 of the desktop app.

title: Timesheet approval still goes to old manager
description: After a department change the approval request keeps going to the previous manager and nothing gets approved until someone notices. HR has to fix the rows by hand each month.

title: Latency chart shows negative numbers
description: The p95 panel on the ops dashboard sometimes drops below zero, which is impossible. Subtracting timestamps from two different hosts with clock skew, the service itself responds normally.

title: Audio only mode for video lessons
description: Students in villages have weak internet connections. A switch for audio only, with slides as still pictures, would let them follow the lesson when video is not an option.

title: Forgot my password flow says account not found
description: I am using the same mail I always use, the login page knows it, but forgot password says "no account found". So I am locked out and cannot place the weekly order.

title: Image upload turns portrait photos sideways
description: Photos taken in portrait on phones show rotated 90 degrees on the property listing page. The EXIF orientation is being ignored by the thumbnail step.

title: Offline mode for field technicians
description: Our technicians work in basements and on remote sites with no signal at all. They need to fill in the work order offline, add photos, and have everything sync when they get back to the van, without losing anything on the way.

title: Let us set a spending limit for each employee card
description: Finance wants to set a monthly limit per person in the expense app and receive a note when somebody gets near it. This is currently not possible.

title: Battery icon shows full when almost empty
description: Tracker reports 100 percent up to the moment it dies. No real power problem here, battery life is what we expect, the ADC reference is just misconfigured in 2.0.

title: Internal package name can be hijacked
description: Our build pulls `acme-utils` from the public registry first. If an attacker registers that name with a higher version, we would install malicious code, a supply chain security risk.

title: CORS allows any origin with credentials
description: Response echoes whatever Origin we send and sets Allow-Credentials: true. Any website can use a visitor's login session to call the API, a security hole.

title: Bus arrival times off by one hour after clock change
description: Since Sunday our app shows every bus an hour late, printed timetable at a stop is right. Looks like daylight saving switch was not handled.

title: The dark theme makes the text unreadable
description: Black text on dark grey on the settings page, you can't read it at all.

title: Single use coupon works many times with parallel requests
description: Sending one coupon in 20 parallel requests applies it several times since the used flag is checked before it is written. Forum users exploit this trick for free goods.

title: First-time teacher tour instead of the PDF guide
description: New teachers get lost and do not read the 40 page guide. A short walkthrough inside the portal itself, with arrows on the real buttons, would cut the calls we get every September.

title: Query builder drops the second WHERE clause
description: In the dashboard query builder, adding a second condition with OR removes the first when you hit run. Generated SQL shows only one clause, so numbers look right but are not.

title: Idea: pair programming timer in the code review tool
description: Our team rotates driver and navigator every 15 minutes. A small built-in timer next to the review pane would be fun and useful, low priority of course.

title: how about a night light mode on the baby monitor
description: the monitor screen is too bright at 3am and wakes me fully. a dim red mode would be wonderful. the rest works great, thank you for that.

title: Admin invite email has broken link
description: The invitation that admins send to new teachers links to localhost:3000. Looks like the base URL env var is missing in production, it is not any kind of access problem.

title: Why is it so slow to tell me my card failed
description: I wait a minute and then it says payment failed even though the money was taken. The waiting I can live with, but my card was charged and the order failed. That part is the problem.

title: Multiple recipients for the weekly report
description: At the moment the report goes to one address only, and I forward it by hand every week. Let me type a list of people, or load them from a group.

title: Image thumbnails 404 after CDN path change
description: Upload service stores a new path, but catalogue still builds URLs with old `/img/` prefix. Product cards fail to load their pictures for anything added since Friday.

title: Replaying a packet duplicates paid currency
description: Capturing the purchase confirmation and sending it again credits gems to any account a second time. Exploit is shared on a forum, a security hole we need to close with server side receipts.

title: Session id is not changed after login
description: Session id stays the same after login, an attacker can plant it beforehand.

title: Multi currency price lists
description: We are opening in two new countries and need one price list per currency instead of a global exchange rate. Is this feature on your roadmap?

title: Pagination links lose the search term
description: Results page 1 is correct for "boots", clicking page 2 shows all products. Looks fast and fine otherwise, the q parameter just isn't carried over in the link.

title: Smart lock pairs over Bluetooth without a PIN
description: Anyone near the door can pair a new phone in the first 10 minutes after a battery swap, with no owner approval and nothing in the app to show it happened. So a burglar can get access just by waiting. Serious security flaw.

title: Documented slow query threshold is wrong
description: Docs say queries over 200 ms get logged. Default has been 1000 ms for ages, as config shows. Nothing wrong with the setting, only the number on this docs page.

title: Chat history scrolling laggy in long threads
description: Threads over a few thousand messages load slowly and scroll in small jumps on my phone, lots of dropped frames. Short chats are smooth, probably too many views kept in memory.

title: Set default landing page per role
description: Cashiers should land on the sales screen, managers on reports. Everybody now lands on the same page, and most need two clicks to get where they work.

title: Export payslips as CSV
description: Feature request: our accountant copies figures by hand every month because the payroll screen can only print. A plain CSV download per pay period would save her a full afternoon.

title: Too slow to open patient file
description: Opening a patient file takes 15 seconds while the patient waits in the room.

title: Insurance number field accepts only ten digits
description: Our national number has eleven digits and this patient form cuts off one without saying anything. Insurer then rejects a claim weeks later, and by that time reception has to call and collect everything all over again.

title: Build cache restores modules from wrong branch
description: Cache key in the pipeline does not include the lockfile hash, so a job on main picked up packages from a feature branch. Tests died with missing module errors nobody could reproduce locally.

title: Comment says seconds but value is milliseconds
description: Sample config page says seconds for `retry_delay`, real unit is ms, the docs mislead people.

title: Your documentation is fine but I want tooltips
description: I read the docs and they're good, but I do not want to leave the screen every time. Could the form fields have small question mark tooltips with a short explanation?

title: Refund still pending after 40 days
description: The status says "refund in progress" since 40 days and my bank has nothing at all. Support tells me that their screen says it is done, so one of your screens is wrong, and I would like you to find out which one.

title: Student ID as PDF in the app
description: It would be good if students could keep a digital student card on their phone for the library and discounts. Many universities around here have this already.

title: Language option for Ukrainian
description: Please add Ukrainian to the patient kiosk, we can help with the translation.

title: Reorder dashboard widgets by dragging
description: Different departments care about different numbers. Let each user drag widgets around and remember that layout, then the start page becomes far more useful.

title: Payment confirmation takes half a minute at peak
description: Between pay click and receipt customers wait 30 seconds on Saturday nights, and many of them think it failed and try again. The bottleneck seems to be fraud rules that run in sequence, so running them in parallel should cut the time a lot.

title: Dry run flag for destructive commands
description: `purge` deletes straight away, a `--dry-run` that lists what goes away is needed.

title: Database CPU at 95 percent during business hours
description: Top query is LIKE '%term%' on customer name with no useful index, pages are slow.

title: Waiting list when a class is full
description: This feature is missing: today students get "class full" and have to check again every day. Instead they could join a queue and be enrolled automatically if someone drops out.

title: Score resets to zero when level restarts
description: Pressing retry on level 4 wipes the total score rather than just that level's points. The old version kept earlier levels, this started with v1.12 on the handheld build.

title: Cannot submit homework if filename has a space
description: My son's school portal takes a few seconds and then says "upload failed" for "math homework.pdf", but after renaming it to mathhomework.pdf it works. Please correct this, the children do not understand why it fails.

title: N+1 queries on the order list
description: 51 SQL queries per order page, load takes 6 seconds on busy days.

title: Pipeline marks failed build as green
description: Deploy stage exits with code 1 but the badge still turns green because the wrapper script swallows the return value. We shipped a broken image twice this week.

title: would be great to have dark mode
description: using the school portal at night for homework and the white screen really hurts. a dark option in settings would be nice, it can be simple.

title: Wrong curl example in payments reference
description: Sample request in the API docs uses `amount_cents`, the real field is `amount`. Copy and paste gives a 400. The API is right, the example on that page is wrong.

title: Fan speed readout says 0 rpm while spinning
description: Controller shows 0 rpm with the fan clearly running at full speed. Tach pulse is read on the wrong pin in hw rev D, so the overheating alarm goes off for no reason.

title: Ticket QR code can be copied and reused
description: QR on concert tickets is just the order number, so anyone with a screenshot gets access at any gate with no check at all. Two people got in on one ticket on Saturday night, the code needs a signature and a one time check.

title: The search button is doing nothing in Firefox
description: Search works in Chrome, in Firefox the button does not respond and pressing enter reloads the page without results. Firefox 128 on Windows 11, no extensions.

title: Warn drivers about rest hours
description: Could the driver app show a warning 30 minutes before the legal driving limit is reached? We track those hours already and could reuse the number.

title: Hotel booking forgets number of children on step 2
description: I entered two adults and one child, on next page it says two adults only and price is lower, then at payment the price change again. I want to know the real price.

title: Security log screen sorts dates wrongly
description: Security log sorted by date puts 10 before 9, the date is treated as text. Entries themselves are complete, just the order on the page is wrong.

title: Long press on message does nothing in Android 15
description: Reply menu no longer opens on long press since Android 15, only the haptic happens.

title: Docs never explain the --force flag
description: `deploy --force` exists and we use it, but no docs page says what it skips. I had to read the source. One paragraph in the CLI reference is enough.

title: Intrusion alert mail says attacker IP is 0.0.0.0
description: Alert template is broken: attacker field is always 0.0.0.0 because it reads a wrong variable. Logs have correct value, and blocking still works as it should.

title: why so slow??
description: every button takes like 5 seconds, newest phone, fast wifi, even settings load slowly.

title: Invite link can be used forever and by anyone
description: Team invite links never expire and anyone can reuse them. One was posted in a public forum and strangers got access to the workspace, a real security incident for us.

title: Bug: saving the profile form can overwrite another account
description: Hidden user_id field in the profile form is not checked against the session. Change it in dev tools and your data gets written onto that other account.

title: Login takes 9 seconds since password hashing change
description: After raising the hash cost to 15 each login blocks a server thread about 9 seconds, and at 8am logins queue up. Too slow, could we use a separate worker pool?

title: Security badge icon missing in dark mode
description: The little shield next to verified sellers disappears when dark theme is on, just a rendering thing with the SVG fill. Nothing to do with actual security checks, the badge is simply invisible.

title: Invoice number jumps by two after failed payment
description: Declined card burns an invoice number, so accounting has gaps in the sequence every week.

title: Install guide fails at step 4
description: Install guide says `pip install -r reqs.txt` but the file is called requirements.txt. Beginners see an error and assume the project is broken, when only the guide needs a fix.

title: Readme for staging contains the real database password
description: Password in the repo's readme is no placeholder, it is what staging uses, and all contractors have access to the repo. Rotate this secret and move it out of the text.

title: refund button greyed out for gift card orders
description: our staff cannot refund anything placed with a gift card, the button stays grey even though the order says paid. bank card orders are fine.

title: Heatmap legend colors inverted on export
description: PNG and SVG exports swap the legend colors, so high values come out blue.

title: Slow motion replay plays at normal speed
description: Replay mode button in our racing game has no effect any more, replay runs at normal speed and that button stays highlighted. Worked up to 2.1.

title: Signup accepts role field from the client
description: POST /signup with role admin creates an admin account, so anyone gets full access. Tested on staging.

title: User manual download gives a 404
description: Download link for our user manual gives a 404 page since site move. Document still exists on server, that route is wrong.

title: Please the app is not opening since update
description: Since yesterday update the app show white screen and then close. I have remove and install again but same problem. My phone is Android 11.

title: Support for multiple delivery addresses
description: I send gifts to my parents and to my office, so I want to store more than one address and choose at checkout.

title: Add example for multi-part upload to guide
description: Upload section of the guide explains parameters but gives no real example. As a beginner I don't understand how parts should be named, a small curl sample would be very kind.

title: Firmware download takes 2 hours over NB-IoT
description: OTA images have grown to 1.4 MB, so each update takes 2 hours of airtime and a lot of battery. Delta updates can reduce the wait a lot.

title: Latency graph empty for the last hour
description: Ops page shows no latency or CPU data for the last hour although the agents report fine. Chart query filters on a renamed field, so the panel is blank.

title: Receipts should stop showing the full card number
description: Emailed receipt includes all sixteen digits of the customer's card, exposed to anyone who reads the mail. We would like only the last four shown, our security auditors will not accept this.

title: Rain gauge counts double in strong wind
description: Reed switch bounce is not filtered, so one tip gets counted twice when the mast shakes. Our weather station reported 40 mm on a day with 20 mm.

title: Save cart between devices
description: I add things on my phone at lunch and want to finish on the laptop at home. Now the cart on the laptop is empty, so I just give up most of the time.

title: Scrolling up in a big group conversation stutters
description: when i scroll back in our 2000 member group the app jerks and stutters, even on a good phone. small groups are perfectly smooth, long chats are just slow to load.

title: Bug report button inside the app
description: Testers want a button which takes a screenshot and opens a form, so they don't have to write long mails. We would like this in the beta build at least.

title: Slow query log full of permission joins
description: Top entry in the slow log is the join for role permissions on every page. Access is correct, it just has no index on role_id and takes 40 percent of database time.

title: Changelog leaves out a breaking change in 4.0
description: Release 4.0 renamed `customerId` to `customer_id` in all responses, yet the changelog page says "minor fixes". Please add a note to the release documentation for the next readers.

title: Release tag pushed before build finished
description: Job tags the commit even when the build takes the retry path, so v2.8.3 has no image.

title: Crash reports should include the app version
description: When testers send a crash report from the app, the mail has no version info and we need to ask them. Would be good to add version and device to the form automatically.

title: Allow manual re-run of a single pipeline job
description: When one flaky job fails we need to restart the whole pipeline. We need a button that re-runs just that job and keeps artifacts from the others.

title: Security officer wants a list of who has which role
description: Not reporting any problem. For our annual review our security officer needs an exportable list of users and their roles. Please add a report for it to the admin panel.

title: Vulnerability report PDF has blank pages
description: Exported vulnerability report has blank pages after page 3. Scan results on screen are fine, the PDF template breaks on long tables.

title: Leave balance goes negative after cancelling a request
description: Cancel an approved holiday request and the days are subtracted a second time instead of returned. One colleague now has minus 4 days on her balance.

title: Test database restore dominates pipeline time
description: Restoring a 30 GB dump takes 18 minutes of a 25 minute pipeline, and we do it for each merge request. A smaller fixture or a snapshot on the runner should make this much faster, and the team stops batching changes to avoid the wait.

title: All employees can read everyone's salary through API
description: GET /api/employees returns the salary field for all staff from any employee account, only the UI hides it. A colleague showed this to me yesterday, so half the office knows about it now, and this broken access control needs a fix today.

title: CSV export allows formula injection
description: Customer can set their account name to =HYPERLINK(...) and when staff open the export in a spreadsheet the formula runs. A security hole, cells starting with = need escaping.

title: Time zone picker for meeting invites
description: Our team spans three countries. Let me choose the time zone when creating a meeting and show both times in the invite text. Does anyone else need this?

title: Pathfinding spikes with more than 50 units
description: One move order to a big army takes almost a second and the game stalls. Each unit uses CPU for its own full path, flow fields reduce that load.

title: Course enrolment counter ignores withdrawn students
description: A course says full with 30 of 30, but 4 of those withdrew. New students cannot enrol even though seats are free. Registrar has to add them by hand.

title: Filter appointments by doctor
description: Reception needs a dropdown to show one doctor at a time on the day view.

title: Permissions page crashes for admins with long names
description: Open Admin, then Permissions: the whole page dies with RangeError: Invalid string length whenever a group name is over 64 chars. No one has lost access, the screen just will not render.

title: Wrong delivery fee on orders going abroad
description: Dear support, when I ship to Portugal the fee in the summary says 4.90 but the invoice says 14.90. This happened on two of my orders, could you please look into it?

title: Spectator mode for tournaments
description: Feature request from our community: we run small tournaments and would love a way for others to watch a live match without playing. A delay of 30 seconds is fine.

title: Live score stuck at half time
description: score stops updating at half time every match, you need to reopen the app.

title: Good morning, my mark for exam 2 is wrong
description: Good morning, in portal my mark for exam 2 shows 12 out of 20 but paper my teacher gave back says 18 out of 20. Other students have same difference, kindly check.

title: Quiz timer keeps running after submit
description: Student submits a quiz and sees thank you page, but countdown in a corner keeps going and at zero it says "time expired". Scares them every time even though score is saved.

title: Wrong doctor name on my appointment letter
description: My letter says Dr. A but when I arrived I was seeing another department. Reception says letter template picks up first doctor of a clinic instead of one booked.

title: Add map view to property search
description: I love looking at listings on a map, not only as a list. Moving and zooming the map should update the results.

title: Error page prints the database connection string
description: Any unhandled exception shows a debug page with the connection string, internal host name and environment variables. Exposed to anonymous visitors on production, a real security risk.

title: Wiring diagram in leaflet swaps SDA and SCL
description: Sensor kit guide has the I2C wires reversed on page 3, the table is right. Please update the manual.

title: Former employees keep access for weeks
description: Accounts of people who left are disabled only at end of quarter, when someone from IT goes through a list by hand. One ex-contractor used his login last week according to our logs, a real security gap that HR offboarding should close right away.

title: Bulk select for grading
description: Feature request: as a teacher I need to mark a whole group of submissions as "received" in one go. Right now that takes 90 clicks for one class.

title: CLI help crashes when terminal is narrow
description: Running `tool --help` in a window under 40 columns raises ValueError: width must be > 0. textwrap gets a negative number after subtracting the indent.

title: Active sessions list in account settings
description: Show my active sessions in account settings with the device name for each. Just handy to see, there is no problem to report.

title: CSV export adds an empty first column
description: All exports from the reporting screen start with a blank column since 5.4, so importing them elsewhere shifts each value one to the right. Looks like an index column with no name.

title: Exam countdown shows seconds where minutes are meant
description: Countdown shows 45 seconds when 45 minutes are left, it takes the value in the wrong unit. Students panic each time the quiz page loads.

title: Booked times shift by an hour in the doctor view
description: Patients book for 10:00 and the physician screen shows 11:00. Started around the daylight saving change. People arrive when the doctor thinks they are late.

title: Discount applied after tax instead of before
description: Invoice shows the 10 percent discount taken off the gross total, while our accounting rules require it before VAT. The VAT line is therefore too high on every discounted order.

title: Translate quick reference card into Spanish
description: Kitchen staff use a one page quick reference guide for the tablet and many read Spanish better than English. A translated version of this guide is needed.

title: Machine translated German manual is confusing
description: German version of the user manual reads like an online translator made it, "save the bank" for "save to database" for example. Could a native speaker review this documentation?

title: Documentation of import format is incomplete
description: Help page lists columns for the product import but never mentions that price needs a dot as decimal separator. Clients get rejected files and the documentation doesn't say why.

title: Spelling mistakes in backup chapter of the manual
description: Chapter 6 of the admin manual has "recieve" and "seperate" several times, plus one section that stops halfway. Please proofread the page before the next edition.

title: Share my location with the courier
description: In new neighbourhoods the courier never finds my door. Let me send my live location for the last 10 minutes so they can see where I am.

title: Date filter off by one day in reports
description: Classic off by one bug: selecting 1 May to 31 May returns rows up to 30 May only. Seems the end date is treated as midnight at the start of that day.

title: Book a room, change date, price stays old
description: Repro: book room for 2 nights, go back, change to 5 nights. Summary still says 2 nights price until you pick a different room type. Paid amount is then the low price.

title: Mobile app startup is 8 seconds on mid-range phones
description: Cold start on a 3 year old phone takes around 8 seconds, mostly initializing SDKs on the main thread. Competing apps load in about 2 seconds.

title: Filename goes unescaped into a shell command
description: Thumbnail step builds a command with the uploaded file name. A file called `a;rm -rf x;.png` runs that on the server, so anyone with an account has command injection. Security fix needed.

title: Glossary in admin guide defines tenant two ways
description: Admin guide uses tenant for a company in one section and a store in another.

title: Docker image is 2.4 GB, cold starts take three minutes
description: App image bundles build tools and test data, and each autoscale event has to wait three minutes for the pull. A multi stage build would load far faster.

title: Clarify supported file sizes in help center
description: Help center page says "large files are supported", but how large? We tell customers 2 GB and they read this and try 10 GB. Docs should state the limit plainly.

title: Gym class shows full with free spots
description: yoga on thursday says 0 spots left but the instructor says there are 6 free. when someone cancels the counter does not go back up.

title: Runbook lacks steps for payment provider outage
description: When the card provider went down nobody knew who to call or what banner to show. Ops documentation should give step by step instructions on a runbook page.

title: Student timetable hides labs on Fridays
description: Friday lab sessions do not appear in the weekly view but do appear in the daily view. Two first year groups missed a lab already because of this.

title: Attendance export drops names with apostrophe
description: Anyone with an apostrophe in a surname disappears from attendance CSV. Class shows 28 students on screen and 26 in that file, teachers noticed during exam registration.

title: Not a bug, just a wish: remember my filters
description: When I come back to the orders page all my filters are back to default, which is how it was designed I suppose. I would prefer it to remember them per user.

title: Replay attack possible on the garage door remote
description: Remote sends the same fixed code each press, so an attacker with a cheap radio can capture it from the street and open the door later. Rolling codes needed, this is a security risk.

title: Delivery slot shows available then errors at payment
description: You can pick a slot, fill in everything, and at the last step get "slot not available". Availability is not rechecked when the slot list is drawn. Frustrating for customers.

title: Recurring tasks in the farm planner
description: i enter the same feeding tasks every sunday, let me make them repeat.

title: Geofence alert for delivery vans
description: We want a notification when a van leaves its assigned district in working hours. Our dispatch team asked for this after a route mixup, though nothing serious happened.

title: docs say default is true, default is false
description: `auto_retry` documented as default true, source says false, just fix the docs page.

title: Gate scanner dies on tickets with umlaut
description: Tickets where the buyer name contains ü make the gate app die with UnicodeDecodeError. We had a long queue at the door on Saturday because of this.

title: Timeout error when device clock is wrong
description: Requests fail instantly with "timeout" on kiosks whose clock is behind, because deadline is computed from server time. Nothing is actually slow, that deadline is simply already past.

title: Changing profile picture with the camera kills the app
description: when i try to make new profile photo with camera app is just closing right after i take the picture. choosing from gallery is working normal. phone is android 13.

title: Steps: filter by supplier, then sort, filter is lost
description: Steps: open purchase orders, filter by supplier, click the date header to sort. Result: the supplier filter is dropped and all orders are listed. Expected: sorted list within that supplier only.

title: Add to calendar button adds wrong day
description: That "add to calendar" option adds training to a day before if you are west of UTC. It is a shipped option, so it should already work, but date math ignores your offset.

title: app is realy slow after last update
description: since last update every screen takes 5 or 6 seconds to load, realy anoying. i use it all day at work and its geting worse.

title: Parking timer ends 15 minutes early
description: paid until 18:00, got the "session over" message at 17:45 and a fine later. happens when the session is extended once. please refund also.

title: Docs for password reset describe old flow
description: Account docs page says the reset link is valid for 7 days and sent by SMS. Now it's 1 hour and sent by mail. Support gets a dozen tickets a month from users who read that.

title: Docs need a warning about crash on old kernels
description: Agent crashes on kernels under 4.15 and we decided not to support them. That's fine, but the requirements page doesn't say so and people keep filing tickets.

title: Game drops to 15 FPS in the harbour level
description: Frame rate falls from 60 to about 15 once ships load, CPU and GPU at 99 percent. Scenes take seconds to respond, other levels run fine.

title: --timeout flag ignored by import command
description: Running `import --timeout 30 data.json` still waits forever when the server does not answer. The value is parsed but never passed down to the HTTP client, see args.py line 77.

title: Support exporting to Parquet
description: Our data team loads the exports into a warehouse. CSV loses all the types, and a Parquet option in the export dialog would make their life a lot easier.

title: Show query time in dashboard footer
description: Our analysts would like a small line saying how long each chart took to load, so they can tell the admins which ones to look at. Just a display option.

title: Error code table skips 429
description: API reference page lists every status code except 429. Partners who hit the limit have no idea what to do, so the errors section of the docs needs an update.

title: Your app is useless without a search box
description: I have 400 recipes saved and there is no way to find one except scrolling. Who designed this? It is a really basic thing and should have been there from day one.

title: Please add caching for the product list
description: Could you add caching to the product list? Each visitor triggers the same heavy query, and database CPU is at 90 percent during lunch. Pages take seconds to load.

title: App closes itself when I rotate phone
description: i am open boarding pass screen and turn my phone, app is close immediately. Android 14, version 5.2.0, before update it was ok.

title: CLI needs 1.5 seconds just to print help
description: `tool --help` takes 1.5 seconds because every subcommand imports pandas at module level. Lazy imports could make short commands load instantly.

title: reminder before subscription renews
description: please send me a message a week before the annual renewal. i do not like surprises on my card, and i may still want to keep it after all.

title: Security headers missing on the customer portal
description: Our security review found no Content-Security-Policy, no HSTS and no Referrer-Policy on the portal. Referrer leaks password reset tokens to a third party script as well.

title: Error page appears when report takes too long
description: Dashboard shows "something went wrong" after 30 seconds, but it isn't a real failure. The report query simply takes 90 seconds, make it faster and the error goes away.

title: Formula text pasted into grid cell gets evaluated
description: Pasted =SUM(1,2) into a cell on the grid view and it saved 3 rather than the text I pasted. Our users want the literal text kept, as it was in version 4.

title: Revoked share links keep working
description: Share feature says "link revoked" but the old URL stays valid until the cached file expires, up to 30 days. People believe access is gone when anyone with the link still has it.

title: Memory usage doubled after upgrade to 3.0
description: Same workload, memory went from 1.1 GB to 2.3 GB after upgrading to 3.0, and pages take seconds longer to load.

title: Report a vulnerability page is empty
description: Security page linked from the footer has a heading and no text. Please write a few lines of instructions on how to report a problem and what we promise in return.

title: Migration 0042 fails on empty table
description: `ALTER TABLE` in migration 0042 assumes at least one row because of the backfill step. New installs die with psycopg.errors.NotNullViolation on first run.

title: Password manager friendly login fields
description: Our testers noted the form has no autocomplete attributes, so password managers are not offering to fill it. A small improvement that users would like to have.

title: instalation guide dosnt mention the new db step
description: i followd the instalation guide but it dosnt say you must create the db first. please add this to the docs.

title: Sound effects way louder after last patch
description: after patch 2.2 the footsteps are super loud and i cant balance the volume, the sfx slider does nothing at all. had to mute the whole game.

title: Cache stats panel in the admin area
description: Ops would like to see cache hit rate and memory usage per node on one panel. Nothing is wrong with the numbers themselves, but today we must log in to each server to read them.

title: Price change history for managers
description: We would like to see who changed a price and when. Nothing bad has happened, we simply want it for the weekly review meeting and for training new staff.

title: Inventory page takes 20 seconds to load
description: Opening the inventory page for our main warehouse takes around 20 seconds, even on the office network. About 40000 items and I think all of them load up front.

title: Unbounded query on notifications table
description: Header bell query loads 50000 rows per page load just to count unread items.

title: Uploaded SVG runs script in the browser
description: Profile pictures accept SVG, and a script tag inside fires when someone opens the image on our domain. Anyone could steal session tokens from logged in users this way.

title: Help text promises instant sync but it runs hourly
description: Settings help page says changes sync "instantly" between devices. Job runs each hour by design according to the team, so the docs sentence should change, not the sync.

title: Artifact upload succeeds but file is truncated
description: Artifacts over 2 GB are cut at exactly 2 GB, with no error from the upload step.

title: Copy button on API token page cuts the token
description: Token page has a copy button which copies only the first 20 characters, so the token fails with a 401. Typing the whole thing works. Nothing is exposed, it is a UI mistake.

title: Support right-to-left layout
description: Mirror the layout for Arabic speakers, we only translate the words right now.

title: Glossary needed for insurance terms
description: Patients don't know what co-pay or deductible mean in billing pages. A short glossary page in the documentation linked from there helps, with an example for each term.

title: Fingerprint login stopped after phone update
description: After system update my fingerprint option is greyed out in your app, even though it works for other apps on this phone. I must type my PIN each time now.

title: App crashes out of memory on albums with 200 photos
description: Gallery decodes every full resolution image at once, about 2 GB of memory on a phone with 3 GB. Loading thumbnails for visible rows only would solve this.

title: Stored XSS in order comments
description: Customer can put HTML in the order comment and it renders unescaped in the back office. An image tag with onerror fired in the admin's browser, so anyone could steal the admin session.

title: Doctor can't save note with percent sign
description: Typing "dose reduced 50%" into the visit note throws an error on save. Without the percent sign it works. Looks like an unescaped format string somewhere in the save path.

title: Hash rounds lowered to speed up login
description: Commit a81f changed password hash rounds from 12 to 4 "to improve performance". That makes cracking a leaked table about 256 times cheaper, please revert this.

title: CPU and memory charts on the device page
description: Our admins want CPU and memory charts per device in the dashboard, the agent already reports these numbers. Nothing is slow, we just want to see them.

title: Manual mode switch ignored by thermostat
description: Manual mode on thermostat page says on, but heating follows its schedule anyway. Guide describes it correctly, firmware just ignores this switch.

title: How payroll rounding works is not documented
description: Payroll admins ask about rounding of hours each month. Manual only says "rounded according to rules". Please document the actual rules in the docs with one or two examples.

title: It should not take 12 clicks to approve a holiday
description: Managers go through three screens for each request. Please add an approve button right in the notification. Nothing is broken, the process is just too long for what it does.

title: Passwords kept in clear text in the users table
description: While debugging I saw that `users.pass` holds plain text passwords. If that table leaks, every password and account goes with it, a serious security vulnerability.

title: Notify seller when item is back in stock
description: When a product sells out, buyers should be able to press "tell me when available" and receive a message when stock returns. We lose those customers today.

title: Could the mobile app use less data
description: Tracking app used 4 GB of mobile data last month, it has to load full size route maps on every screen. Compression would save drivers real money and many seconds per screen.

title: Read only role for external auditors
description: We need a new role that can see everything and change nothing, so the auditor can work in the system and we stop exporting files for them each quarter.

title: Inventory duplicates items after merging stacks
description: Drag one stack of arrows on another while the server lags, and you end up with both stacks plus the merged one. Players are already farming this. Build 1.7.3.

title: Unsubscribe link keeps you subscribed
description: Clicking unsubscribe shows a success page yet the next newsletter arrives anyway. Checked the table, the flag never flips for addresses containing uppercase letters.

title: Docs still call the product by its old name
description: We renamed the app two years ago and half of the docs pages use the old name, even inside code examples. It looks careless, so please update them.

title: Monthly report spins for a minute then shows TypeError
description: TypeError at /reports/monthly: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'NoneType' and 'int'. Page spins for a minute only because of retries, the root problem is the None in the totals for new customers.

title: Default login admin/admin still works on the gateway
description: Gateways ship with a default admin password, nothing forces a change at first boot, and anyone can log in and get access.

title: Penalty mode: attacker runs in place after the whistle
description: In our football game an attacker sometimes keeps running in place when a whistle blows and no kick happens. Restarting a match is your only way out.

title: Falling through floor in sewer level
description: Bug report: rolling into a corner near that second ladder drops you through geometry and you fall forever. Checkpoint then respawns you in that same spot, so your save is ruined.

title: Regex in validator rejects new domain endings
description: Signup form refuses any address ending in a TLD longer than four letters, which blocks valid customers. The pattern has been hard coded since 2019.

title: Please let me change the delivery date after ordering
description: Plans change. If the parcel hasn't left yet I would like to pick another day myself in the order page, without having to wait for customer service.

title: FPS counter shows negative values after alt-tab
description: The little overlay reads -1 fps after you switch back to the window. Frame rate itself feels completely normal, only the overlay math is wrong.

title: Bug report template points at the old tracker
description: Link in CONTRIBUTING.md under "reporting a bug" leads to a tracker we shut down. That section of the guide needs a new link and a note on which labels to use.

title: Request timeout value is in ms, not seconds
description: We set `timeout=30` and every call fails at once with a timeout error, because the client now reads the number as milliseconds after 4.0. Changelog never said so, but the real issue is that nothing is ever slow here, the code aborts instantly.

title: Deprecation warnings flood the production log
description: Thousands of lines per hour saying that a date helper is deprecated. Nothing fails yet, but the logs cost money and they hide real errors. Started after the framework bump to 6.2.

title: Explain the difference between draft and pending
description: Status names in the invoice module aren't explained in the user guide, and support gets this question weekly from new bookkeepers. A small table on that page of the documentation, listing each status and what can change, answers it for good.

title: Release notes for 5.2 list something that did not ship
description: Release notes page for 5.2 says bulk edit shipped, which actually moved to 5.3. These docs need an update.

title: quiet hours for notifications
description: i dont want the app buzzing at 2am when someone posts in the parents group. let me set hours when it stays quiet, but keep urgent messages from school.

title: Slow file listing on network drives
description: Listing a share with 50000 files takes several minutes, because `stat` runs on each file one at a time. Batching the metadata calls would be a major relief.

title: Grades tab blank for students with two majors
description: For students enrolled in two programmes the grades tab fails to load and stays white. Console shows TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'credits').

title: Changing the id in the URL shows another patient's booking
description: If I change /bookings/1041 to /bookings/1042 after login I can see the name and visit reason of a stranger. I am only a patient, I should not have access to that.

title: Show who has access to my shared folder
description: I want a list of people with access on each shared folder, so I can tidy up. Nothing went wrong, I only lost track of who is in there.

title: API docs example returns 500 in sandbox
description: Copying the example request from the reference exactly gives a 500 in sandbox while the same body on production works. Text of the docs is correct, sandbox is missing a seed row and throws.

title: Add docs link to the top menu
description: Users don't find our help center since nothing in the app points to it. Please add an item in the top menu next to the profile icon. The articles themselves are fine.

title: App language switches back to English each morning
description: I have set the app to Turkish but it goes back to English every day when I open it the first time. Change it again and it stays until the next day.

title: Dropdown with 20000 options freezes the form
description: Supplier dropdown with 20000 DOM nodes takes 12 seconds to load, the whole form is slow because of it.

title: Searchable manual on the oven touch screen
description: Our ovens have a big touch screen but the manual is on paper and gets lost. Put the manual on the device itself, with search, and link it from the settings page.

title: Would be great if the report opened in under a minute
description: Our quarterly report takes around 8 minutes to load and managers think it has hung. I am not asking for new columns, just less waiting.

title: Power saver mode for long hikes
description: Normal battery life on the tracker is great. I would like an extra mode which reports position every hour only, for multi-day trips with no way to charge.

title: Nothing happens when I press Confirm
description: i press confirm on the booking and nothing happens, no message, no nothing. tried 5 times. i need this appointment for my mother next week!!

title: Account locked message shows wrong time
description: After three bad password tries the login page says locked for 30 minutes, but the account is in fact free again after 5. The text is hard coded, the timer is right.

title: Login succeeds then bounces back to login screen
description: After entering correct credentials on the school portal I see the home page for a few seconds and then I am back at login. Only in Chrome, my other browser is fine.

title: Student attendance by QR code
description: Instead of calling names the teacher could show a code on the projector and students scan it on their phone from their seat. This takes five minutes per lesson off the roll call, and the list is then in the system right away.

title: Docs unclear on data after cancelling plan
description: Pricing FAQ page doesn't say whether exports stay available after cancelling. Customers ask before they sign, a section in the docs from legal would clear that up.

title: ConcurrentModificationException when closing a shift
description: Stack: java.util.ConcurrentModificationException at ShiftService.closeAll(ShiftService.java:318). Occurs when two supervisors close shifts at the same moment, and one of them gets a 500.

title: Deployment password printed in pipeline log
description: Deploy job echoes the production password in the log, anyone with repo access sees it.

title: Option to hide mini-map
description: can we get an option to hide the mini-map? on small screens it takes up too much space, and experienced players don't need it anyway.

title: Wrong language after logout
description: My account is French but after logging out and in again everything is in English until I open settings and press save with no changes. Merci de corriger.

title: Load test script reports 0 failures when server is down
description: Our stress job prints a perfect summary even if every request errored. Result parser counts only HTTP 5xx, not connection refused, so the numbers mean nothing.

title: Back button resubmits payment form
description: Nasty bug: pressing back on the confirmation page and forward again resends the POST. No redirect after post, so a confused customer can pay twice.

title: No way to undo a sent invoice, this is a problem
description: We sometimes send an invoice with a typo and there is no recall or void action at all, and we end up calling the customer. Nothing is broken, it just has never existed. Please add it.

title: Night theme for student portal app
description: Please can the student portal app get a night theme? I study late and the bright white pages are tiring for my eyes. Maybe a simple switch in the settings menu.

title: Schedule firmware updates for night hours
description: Updates start right when the user approves them, and the heating goes off for 5 minutes. Letting people pick a night window would avoid complaints in winter.

title: Slowdown after running for several days
description: Kiosk app gets more and more sluggish, and after 4 or 5 days needs a restart. Memory graph climbs slowly the whole time and each screen needs seconds to appear.

title: 429 returned without Retry-After header
description: Rate limited responses from the gateway no longer include Retry-After, and our client library falls back to hammering every 100 ms. The header was there until 2.14.

title: Token refresh loop logs users out every hour
description: Refresh call returns 401 because we send the expired access token in the header rather than the refresh token. Users get thrown to the login page during long forms and lose their work.

title: Keyboard covers message box in landscape
description: when i turn my phone sideways text box is hidden under keyboard and i type blind, anyone else? portrait works ok. it is like this since new design.

title: README has no Windows setup steps
description: Readme only covers Linux and macOS. Please add a Windows section to the docs, virtualenv path differs and beginners get stuck on day one.

title: Handshake takes 4 seconds on the small gateway
description: TLS handshake on the 200 MHz gateway takes 4 seconds with RSA 4096. Session resumption would reduce the cost of each reconnect a lot.

title: Boot loop when config file has a BOM
description: If the JSON config is saved with a UTF-8 BOM the parser fails, the device falls into recovery, and recovery reloads the same file. Happens with files edited on Windows.

title: Missing option makes the report useless for us
description: The sales report only groups by month, which is wrong for us as we plan in weeks. Add group by week and the report becomes useful.

title: Slow mode toggle in chat channel does nothing
description: Slow mode in our chat channel has no effect: users can post every second even with the wait time set to 60 seconds. Worked until the last release.

title: Slow headers can tie up all our workers
description: One client opening 200 connections and sending headers a byte at a time keeps every worker busy, so normal users get no access at all. No header timeout on the web tier, anyone can do this.

title: Developer notes on caching layer are missing
description: Only one person understands how cache keys are built. Please document this in the repo docs or wiki before he goes on leave, with an example of purging keys.

title: Open redirect in login next parameter
description: /login?next=//evil.example redirects there after a successful login. Great for phishing, as the link starts with our real domain, and someone could steal the account password.

title: Documentation build shows wrong version number
description: Documentation header on every page says v4.1, latest release is v4.3, someone forgot to update it.

title: Avatar upload says too big for tiny images
description: My picture is only 200 KB and the limit is 5 MB, it still says too big. Other people in my class have this as well. Maybe a unit problem somewhere?

title: System should warn about double booking of rooms
description: Today two teachers can book the same lab without any warning, and find out at the door. A warning at booking time, with an override, would suit us well.

title: Library with a known CVE in the image pipeline
description: Our image library version has a published remote code execution vulnerability, rated 9.8, and we process user uploads with it. Security says upgrading should not wait for the next sprint.

title: Secret scanning step flags its own config
description: Our pipeline scanner fails every build by matching the regex examples inside its own rules file. The ignore list is not applied to that path, and nobody can merge today.

title: Old password still works after a reset
description: I reset my password because I thought someone had it. New one works but the old password still gets access to my account for at least a day. That's a security problem.

title: Garage door app reports closed while opening
description: The status changes to closed the moment you press the button, before the door has moved at all. 20 seconds later it corrects itself. Firmware 5.1, app 2.9.

title: Index out of bounds parsing short barcode
description: Barcodes under 8 digits raise IndexOutOfBoundsException in EanParser line 41 and the whole scan session ends. Fast fix: check length first, nothing to do with search index or speed.

title: pytest collects zero tests after folder rename
description: After moving tests to `tests/unit`, the pipeline happily reports "0 passed" and goes green. conftest path needs updating, and we should fail on zero collected as well.

title: fitness tracker counts driving as steps
description: i drove 2 hours and got 9000 steps. it was never this bad before the 1.8 update. makes the whole weekly challenge pointless.

title: README claims 10k requests per second, we see 400
description: Same hardware as the benchmark section, yet latency is far higher. Our profile shows most CPU time inside JSON logging on the request path, which keeps throughput well below what was promised.

title: Reset codes can be guessed
description: Reset tokens are just user id plus current date in base64, I worked out the pattern in ten minutes. Anyone can craft a token for any account.

title: Request access button sends blank message
description: Note typed into request access box does not reach an approver, they get a mail with an empty body and requester's id only. Field name mismatch in that form.

title: Podcast resumes from the start after a call
description: Phone call interrupts an episode, and when it ends the episode starts from zero rather than where it stopped. I always lose my place. v3.3 on Android 14.

title: Update documentation for new tax codes
description: Tax codes changed in January, the screens are updated but the documentation shows the old list. Finance teams need the new page before year end.

title: Page load counter counts each visit twice
description: Analytics tile says twice the real page load count, each load fires the tracking call two times. Nothing is slow, the numbers are just doubled.

title: Stale data after switching tenants
description: Support staff switching between customer accounts still see charts from the previous tenant until they hard refresh. Only the frontend store is stale, it takes the old data from memory while the API returns correct data.

title: My account was opened by other person
description: Yesterday somebody is login in my account from other country and changed my password without any mail to me. How this is possible? Please to check the security.

title: Watchdog resets gateway when uplink is down
description: If the LTE modem fails to attach within 60 s the main loop blocks and the watchdog fires, so the gateway reboots forever. Seen on hw rev C with fw 3.3.2.

title: Boss door never opens after reloading a save
description: If you save inside crypt and reload, door to final room stays locked even with its key in your inventory. Had to restart whole chapter, very annoying!

title: Translation tool drops text after a newline
description: Only the first line of a paragraph gets translated when the source has a line break in it, everything below is silently dropped. Ate half a contract before anyone noticed.

title: debug endpoint open in production
description: /debug/env returns all secrets with no login, reachable from the public internet.

title: tutorial 3 links to a dataset that is gone
description: third tutorial page starts with a dead download link, students stop right there. please update this guide.

title: Pls add arabic numbers option in the invoice
description: some of our customers want to see numbers in arabic numerals on their invoice. it is possible? the name of customer already prints good in arabic.

title: Deadlock on invoice number table during month end
description: Two batch jobs lock the sequence row and the customer table in opposite order, Postgres kills one with "deadlock detected" and the invoices from that job are lost.

title: Proxy cache serves my account page to other visitors
description: Account page is cacheable because of a missing header. A colleague opened it after me and got access to my name, address and orders. Not a speed topic, private data is going to strangers.

title: Send invoice by mail automatically when paid
description: Accounting would like the invoice attached to a confirmation mail right after payment, without someone clicking "send" in the back office. Can it be a setting per shop?

title: Report columns are not explained anywhere
description: Monthly report has columns like NRR and adj_qty with no explanation anywhere in the manual or on the help pages. Our managers have asked me about them twice now, so please add a section or a page that documents each column.

title: Debug UART gives root shell on production boards
description: Connecting to the UART pads drops you into a root shell with no login. Combined with the shared key this exposes the whole fleet, so any attacker who buys one gets access.

title: Download next lesson while on wifi
description: I don't want to wait on the bus for the next lesson to load. Let the app download it at home on wifi, as a simple option in settings.

title: Employee can approve own expense with edited request
description: Approve call only checks that you have a login session, not that you are the manager. I changed the id and approved my own expense on test, no access check.

title: Lock screen shows diagnosis in push notification
description: Clinic app notifications include the test name and result in the preview text, even with the phone locked. Anyone who picks up my phone can read that private medical data, and I cannot find a setting to turn it off. This is a privacy problem.

title: Push notification opens the wrong conversation
description: Tapping a notification from one friend takes me to the chat of whoever I talked to last. Happens on iOS 17, only when the app was already in the background.

title: Nightly ETL now spills into business hours
description: Yesterday's load finished at 10:40, so dashboards were empty all morning and the sales team worked without numbers. Row counts doubled this year and this job still reloads everything rather than only new rows, so it takes far too long.

title: Taking longer than usual message always shown
description: The spinner text "this is taking longer than usual" appears immediately on every login, even when the request finishes in under a second. Timer constant got set to 0 in the last refactor.

title: Public wiki page lists internal VPN details
description: How-to guide on the public wiki includes the VPN host name and the shared login for the test network. Indexed by search engines for months, a security exposure.

title: Favourites list for products
description: I often find something I like but do not want to buy it right now. Can you give me a way to mark favourites, and find them again next time I log in?

title: Report slows down as the year goes on
description: In January this report loads in seconds, in December it takes minutes. It reads all transactions of the year and filters in code, filtering belongs in the SQL query.

title: Can we have a sandbox tenant for training
description: New hires practice on live data since we have no test environment for them. A resettable demo tenant would make our onboarding much safer and simpler.

title: Passwords hashed with unsalted MD5
description: Legacy accounts use unsalted MD5, a leaked dump gives away every password in hours. This vulnerability needs a stronger hash.

title: OTA update bricks nodes with low battery
description: Update starts at 8 percent charge, brownout happens during flash write, and the node never boots again. There is no battery check before writing the image.

title: Crash on empty playlist
description: IndexError in player/queue.py line 58 when a playlist has zero episodes, the app dies.

title: Feature flags service adds 200 ms to each page
description: Every request asks the flag service over the network 8 or 9 times, adding 200 ms of latency per page load. A local copy refreshed each minute would be enough.

title: Mobile app does not verify TLS certificates
description: With a self signed proxy cert the app still connects and sends the login password. An attacker on public wifi could read all traffic.

title: Audit logging blocks every write
description: Each save has to wait for a synchronous insert in the audit table, adding 150 ms of latency to all writes. The log must stay, but should be written in the background.

title: Frame stutter every few seconds in the open world
description: small hitch every 3 to 5 seconds in town, looks like allocation bursts when npcs load.

title: Blank page when opening a shared dashboard link
description: People who open a shared report without being logged in get a blank page, the login form does not load. Console: Uncaught ReferenceError: currentUser is not defined.

title: Two column view on large tablets
description: Show patient list and details side by side on big tablets, there is room.

title: Item appears in cart after I removed it
