description: I remove the shoes, they disappear, I go to another page and the shoes are back. Tried on 2 different browsers, has anyone looked at this? It is really frustrating when you try to pay.

title: Docs claim feature exists on the free plan
description: Pricing docs say bulk export is on the free plan, it never was. Product confirmed the plan is right and the documentation should change.

title: Please make the slow path optional: skip image preview
description: On my old phone I would like a setting to turn off image previews in the list. It's not your fault that the phone is old, but this option would make it nicer for me.

title: Warehouse scanner beeps success on unknown barcode
description: Handheld accepts barcodes that are not in our catalogue and adds a blank line to a pick list. Pickers only notice at packing table.

title: Timeline view in the security camera app
description: Add a timeline to the security camera app so I can jump to motion events. Scrolling through a full day of video is no fun.

title: Error message shows another customer's order number
description: Trying to pay gave me "order 88213 for customer MK is locked". That isn't my order or my initials, and I should not have access to another person's account data.

title: Request: invoice due date reminders
description: We would like the system to mail customers 3 days before an invoice is due and again on the day after. Today our office makes these calls by hand.

title: Tip the driver after delivery
description: Let customers leave a tip after the food arrives, not only at checkout.

title: Pinned messages in group chat
description: Let group admins pin an important message to the top of the chat.

title: Encrypted notes app shows wrong note count
description: Folder says 12 notes and only 9 are listed. The hidden ones appear after a sync, so nothing leaked or got lost, the counter simply includes deleted items.

title: Performance review form loses second page
description: HR tool: filling in the yearly performance review, and on submit the answers on page two are not saved. Managers have to retype them. No error message is shown.

title: 3D printer pauses at layer 256
description: Every print stops at exactly layer 256 with no error on the display. An 8-bit counter somewhere? Prints under that height finish without trouble.

title: Forum post preview eats code blocks
description: Anything between backticks vanishes in the preview section, and then appears correctly after posting. Makes it hard to check before you publish a question.

title: Idempotency keys for POST /payments
description: Support an `Idempotency-Key` header so that clients can retry safely after a network error.

title: Our members ask for family accounts
description: Parents want one payment for the whole family with separate logins for the kids, so that each child can book classes but nobody else sees the card details. Is this planned? At our gym it is the top request of the year.

title: GraphQL query depth has no limit
description: A nested query with 30 levels ties up the database, and anyone can send one without login. Please add depth limits and turn off introspection, a clear security gap.

title: Cache hit rate fell to 20 percent
description: After the redesign CDN cache key includes full query string with tracking params, so nearly all requests go to origin. Origin CPU doubled and pages take seconds longer to load.

title: Security deposit charged twice on booking
description: When a guest changes dates of a holiday flat, security deposit is charged again on top of their first one. Owner sees one deposit, guest's card shows two.

title: Wrong jumper position in flashing manual
description: Page 12 of the manual says to set J3 to the left for flashing. On rev C boards it must be right, left gives "no device found". Board and firmware are fine, the manual is wrong.

title: Sort by price treats numbers as text
description: Product search sorts 100, 20, 3 since the varchar migration lost the cast.

title: Docs search box returns 500
description: Typing anything into search on our help site gives an Internal Server Error and a stack trace from search service. Pages themselves are fine, nothing wrong in their content.

title: in the guide is written wrong path
description: In your guide is written to put the file in /etc/app but in new version it must be /opt/app/conf. I lost half day because of this, please update this page.

title: Video call screen is black on my side only
description: The other person can see me but my side does not load any video, only black, audio is fine. Using version 9.3 on an old laptop, it worked last week.

title: Webhook for new ticket created
description: We need a webhook when a new ticket comes in, polling every minute is wasteful.

title: Docs site takes 12 seconds to load
description: Content of the guide is good, but the docs page takes 12 seconds on my connection because it pulls a 9 MB search index before showing any text. Could this load lazily?

title: Cart total ignores removed item
description: Old total stays on screen after removing an item, until you refresh the page.

title: Auto-lock delay setting ignored by smart lock
description: Set auto-lock to 30 seconds in app and lock still waits its default 5 minutes. Setting appears saved when you reopen that screen. Firmware 1.4.7.

title: Size guide popup covers Add to cart button
description: Opening the size guide on a phone puts a popup over the Add to cart button, and closing it does nothing until you scroll. Customers think that the shop is broken.

title: Contributing guide does not mention lint step
description: First time contributors get failing checks since nobody tells them about `make lint`. Instructions should be added to the contributing guide, plus a section on the pre-commit hook.

title: As an admin, I need to clone a user profile
description: New staff usually need the same access as a colleague. Cloning a profile would avoid forgetting a permission and spare us ticking 40 boxes each time.

title: Token kept in plain shared preferences
description: Android app keeps the auth token unencrypted, a rooted phone exposes the account and its session to anyone.

title: Keyboard shortcuts so we can work faster
description: Our data entry people use the mouse for everything because no shortcuts exist. Ctrl+S to save and arrow keys between fields would make the team a lot quicker.

title: group expenses by project in the mobile app
description: we travel for several clients in one trip. if i can choose the project per receipt, the monthly summary makes sense to our accountant.

title: Referral codes for existing customers
description: Marketing wants customers to get a personal code they can share. Both sides get 5 euro off, with a limit of 10 uses per person.

title: Storage bucket with invoices is public
description: Bucket holding customer invoices allows anonymous access, so anyone who knows the name can download every PDF with names and addresses. Serious data exposure.

title: Wiki search returns 403 for everyone
description: Our internal wiki page search returns 403 since the upgrade, even for admins. Pages open fine when you know the link.

title: Reschedule an appointment without calling
description: Patients should be able to move their own booking to another free slot up to 24 hours before. Our phone lines are overloaded with exactly this.

title: AttributeError in nightly ETL
description: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'strip' at transform.py:211 when the source file has a blank currency cell. The whole job aborts and yesterday's numbers stay on the dashboard.

title: Upload scanner fails open when its container is down
description: When the antivirus container isn't running the upload step logs "clean" because the error path returns the default. We found out after two days, files went through with no security check.

title: Documentation for webhooks lacks signature example
description: Documentation page explains the signature header in words with no code sample, and most integrators make the same mistake with the raw body. A short example in two languages, maybe 10 lines each, would save them hours and save us many tickets.

title: Stack trace when run outside a repo
description: Tool prints a Traceback with FileNotFoundError on first run in any folder that was not initialised.

title: Vending machine keeps coins after failed vend
description: If motor jams, machine reports "vend failed" and does not return credit. Audit log does record this failure, but refund routine is never called.

title: Security questions step will not save my answers
description: In the account setup wizard the page with the security questions says saved but then asks again, so I am stuck on that step. Nobody's data is at risk, the form just loops.

title: Not sure if bug but dashboard needs 40 seconds
description: Numbers are correct, nothing is broken. It just takes 40 seconds to load the sales dashboard each morning, and my team goes for coffee while it runs.

title: Possible to merge two customer records?
description: We often get the same customer twice with slightly different spelling. An admin action for merging them, and keeping the orders from both, is what we need.

title: App crash log uploaded with session token inside
description: Crash reports sent to our analytics vendor include the Authorization header. I checked one sample and the token was valid. Those secrets are visible to a lot of people.

title: Hidden price field can be changed at checkout
description: Checkout form posts the price from a hidden field and the server trusts it. I bought a 200 euro item for 1 euro with a test account on staging, someone will find this vulnerability soon.

title: Missing index on appointments.patient_id
description: Patient history query takes 3.4 seconds, sequential scan on 12 million rows, needs an index.

title: Shift swap request disappears after accepting
description: My colleague accepted my swap but the roster still shows me on Saturday, and the request is gone from both our inboxes. Who is actually working then?

title: Null pointer on patient merge
description: Merging two patient records where one has no birth date: NullPointerException at MergeService.java:90. Receptionists see only "something went wrong" and retry forever.

title: Scan of my prescription is rejected every time
description: File is a normal JPG under the size limit, but the pharmacy app says "wrong format" when I send it as documentation for my insurance. The pharmacy itself can open the same file.

title: Scheduled report mails an empty attachment
description: Weekly sales report arrives Monday as usual but the xlsx has only the header row. Running the same report by hand gives 2400 lines.

title: Controller vibrates forever after pausing
description: pause during an explosion and the rumble never stops until you unplug the pad.

title: Thermostat UI takes 3 seconds per button press
description: Since firmware 6 the display redraws entirely on each press and the MCU can't keep up. Pressing temp up five times takes 15 seconds, far too slow.

title: Pagination example missing from API docs
description: API docs describe `cursor` in one line, an example with two pages is needed.

title: Dosing pump runs twice after wifi reconnect
description: When the controller loses wifi and comes back, the queued dose runs again on top of the scheduled one. We nearly burned a greenhouse section, please treat this as urgent.

title: Stock alert fires for items with stock
description: Low stock mail lists products that have plenty on hand, because reserved units are subtracted twice. Purchasing has started ignoring these mails altogether.

title: Removed member still receives group messages
description: After I removed someone from our group they still had access to new messages for a day, as the encryption key wasn't rotated. This is a privacy and security issue.

title: Attach files to support tickets
description: Customers can only write text in the ticket form, then send screenshots and supporting documentation separately by mail, which get lost. Attachments right on the ticket please.

title: Broken experience on old tablets, everything lags
description: Since the redesign tapping anything on our older clinic tablets takes 3 or 4 seconds and animations stutter. All features work, it's just painfully slow at reception.

title: Help page is not opening from inside app
description: When I press that question mark an empty white window opens. I can read docs on your website fine, it is only this in-app button that fails.

title: Generate API docs from code comments
description: We write the same text twice, in code comments and on the docs site. A build step that creates the API docs from comments saves time and keeps them in step.

title: Upgrade guide skips a required migration step
description: Followed the 3.x to 4.x upgrade instructions and the app failed with a missing column error. The guide has to mention `migrate --fake-initial` before step 5, it is not on the page.

title: Readme table of contents is out of date
description: Readme table of contents links to renamed sections, quick documentation cleanup needed.

title: Negative quantity creates store credit
description: Changing quantity to -5 in the request gives a negative total and adds credit to the account. No server validation, anyone can do it, the browser field is no security control.

title: Symlinks copied as empty files by backup tool
description: Using `archive --follow=no` stores symlinks as zero byte files, and a restore silently loses them. Noticed only when restoring a project with a linked vendor folder.

title: Nice to have: drag files directly into chat
description: on desktop i have to click the clip, navigate to the folder and choose. dragging a file straight onto the conversation is how every other tool works.

title: Dashboard refresh hammers the database
description: All open dashboards refresh every widget each 30 seconds, and 400 people keep one open all day. Database load is huge, pause when the tab is hidden and cache for a minute.

title: New recommendation feature made the home page heavy
description: Since "you may also like" shipped, the home page makes 40 API calls and takes 7 seconds to load on 4G. Works and looks nice, but far too slow for a first page.

title: Barcode scanning in the mobile inventory app
description: Staff want to use the phone camera for scanning shelf labels rather than typing product codes on that tiny keyboard. It saves a lot of time.

title: Password strength meter always says weak
description: Password meter stays on weak for any password, because the script fails to load its word list. The account gets created fine anyway.

title: Payroll run times out at about 5000 employees
description: Run is single threaded and takes over 2 hours at 5000 people, so the job gets killed. Parallel processing per department would make it much less slow.

title: Time tracking for each task in project board
description: Consultants need to log hours against a task, not only per day. A start and stop button on each card, so anyone on the project can see totals, is how we imagine it.

title: PUT /v2/customers wipes fields that were not sent
description: A partial body on PUT /v2/customers/{id} sets every missing field to null. The docs clearly say partial updates are allowed, so the docs are fine and the handler is what needs fixing.

title: Calendar export (ICS) for exam dates
description: Students ask for a subscribe link or ICS file with their exam dates.

title: Log parser reads whole file into memory
description: Parsing a 40 GB access log needs 40 GB of memory since lines are collected in a list first, and it takes minutes before printing anything. Too slow, a generator keeps memory flat.

title: sync command exits 0 on partial upload
description: `sync --all` prints done and exits 0 even when two of the files got a 503.

title: Allow nicknames in class list
description: Many international students go by another name in class. Is it possible to show a preferred name beside the official one in the teacher's list?

title: Teacher comment shows under wrong assignment
description: Our teacher wrote feedback on a history essay, and it is displayed under math homework. Same for three other pupils in class, looks like ids are mixed.

title: Plese add a calender view for shifts
description: it would be realy usefull to see all my shifts in a calender view and not just a list. thanks in advance.

title: Add a size guide for shoes
description: People return a lot of shoes because they guess the size. A size guide on each product page, with a little table per brand, is what customer service keeps asking for.

title: Admin panel reachable without login
description: /admin/reports opens with no login if you know the URL, no access check.

title: Audio message plays at double speed
description: Voice notes recorded on Android play at twice the speed on iOS, chipmunk style. Sample rate is written wrongly into the header, I would guess.

title: Access requests past page one cannot be opened
description: Admin access requests past page one can't be opened, the pagination link returns 500. Users wait for weeks with no account approval because of it.

title: Readme preview renders tables as plain text
description: Repository page shows readme tables as raw pipes since yesterday. Markdown renderer upgrade seems to have dropped that extension, the readme itself is correct.

title: Cannot access my account after app update
description: Since version 6.1 the login screen says "something went wrong" with my correct password, on two phones. The website still lets me in, so my account itself is fine and the app is the problem.

title: Typo on the checkout button
description: The main button reads "Procede to payment". Not a big thing but it is on our most visited page and customers do mention it. Should be a one line fix in the template.

title: Allow overriding tax rate per line item
description: Some of our products have a reduced rate, and our invoices have only one rate per document. Accounting needs this per line before next quarter.

title: Connection pool setting has no effect
description: `DB_POOL_SIZE=50` in env file is ignored, app always opens default of 5 because config loader reads `POOL_SIZE`. A simple naming mismatch from that refactor.

title: Worker memory grows until the pod is OOM killed
description: payment-worker goes from 300 MB to 2 GB in about nine hours and then gets OOM killed, and in-flight jobs are lost. Looks like event listeners that are never removed.

title: Need search inside chat history
description: a search field inside one conversation please, scrolling back for months is no fun.

title: Show estimated wait time at reception screen
description: Patients keep asking how long it will be. We have the check-in times, so an estimate on the waiting room screen seems doable.

title: Subtitles out of sync after skipping forward
description: Subtitles stay several seconds behind after jumping ahead in any course video.

title: promo code field dissapears on mobile
description: the promo code field dissapears when i scroll down on my phone and i cant enter my code. definately a problem on the newest version.

title: Mock server returns stale fixture in CI
description: Integration tests pass locally and fail on the runner, since the mock image is pinned to an old tag with the previous response shape. Can anyone bump it?

title: Sound keeps playing after closing video lesson
description: Kids close a lesson video on their tablet and audio carries on behind our menu. Only way to stop it is a force close, has anyone else seen this?

title: Achievement unlocks at wrong boss
description: Bug: "Dragon slayer" pops when you beat the troll in chapter 2, then never unlocks for the real dragon. Save files that already got it can't get the true one.

title: Kiosk keyboard lags behind typing
description: On check-in kiosks each letter appears a full second after key press, as validation takes that long on each keypress. That slow response makes elderly patients press again.

title: Timetable calculation takes 4 hours
description: Solver for the school timetable takes 4 hours of CPU for only 90 teachers, and in September we rerun it ten times a day because teachers keep changing their availability. Too slow for that kind of work, a greedy first pass would help a lot.

title: Statement endpoint returns 504 for long histories
description: Customers with over a year of data get a 504. Query takes around 70 seconds and the proxy gives up at 60, so it needs a faster query, not a longer timeout.

title: Login audit report misses last day of month
description: Compliance asked for the login report for May and rows from 31 May are absent. Same off by one that we fixed once in the sales report, but this query has its own copy.

title: Empty array serialized as null in invoice API
description: A customer with no line items gets `"items": null` rather than `[]`, which crashes the mobile client on `.map`. Changed in the serializer upgrade.

title: Add wishlist to product pages
description: Customers ask us all the time if they can save items for later without putting them in the cart. A simple heart icon and a list in their account is all we need.

title: Memory limit resets to default on restart
description: Memory limit I set in the admin page goes back to 512 MB after each restart. Seconds later the config file has the old value again, so the save never sticks.

title: Rate limiter table makes every request wait
description: Protection against an attacker hammering login is fine, but the limiter does a full scan of its table on each request and adds 300 ms of latency.

title: timezone offset dropped in date serialization
description: API accepts 2026-03-14T09:00:00+03:00 and returns 2026-03-14T09:00:00Z, so bookings silently move three hours. PATCH then saves the shifted value.

title: Password expiry reminder for staff
description: Staff get locked out when their password expires without warning. A reminder a week before, with a link to change it, is what our helpdesk asks for.

title: Compose snippet in docs uses deprecated key
description: Compose snippet on the deployment docs page still has `links:` and `version`, needs an update.

title: Promo banner covers checkout button on tablets
description: On a tablet in landscape our summer promo banner sits right on top of Place Order. You can only reach that button by turning your device, and I am sure many customers simply leave instead of trying that.

title: Weekly summary mail for parents
description: Instead of many small notices, parents could get one mail each Friday with marks, absences and messages for the week. I think parents prefer that a lot.

title: Alert when a sensor stops sending data
description: If a probe goes silent for more than 2 hours, send me a message. Right now I discover it days later when I look at the graph by accident.

title: Recurring appointment skips February
description: Monthly follow-up on the 30th just disappears in February rather than moving to the 28th. A patient missed her check because nothing was booked that month, and nobody at reception could see it, since the series still looks complete in the overview.

title: empty descriptions in patients api docs
description: half of the fields under /patients have no description, so the generated docs page shows blank cells. new integrators can't guess what `ref_type` means without an example.

title: Payroll bonus applied to wrong pay period
description: Bonus entered for June ends up in the July run if entered after the 20th, although the screen says June. Finance had to correct 18 payslips by hand.

title: Slow query log rotation deletes today's file
description: Cleanup cron for slow query logs removes current file too, since date pattern matches it. Database itself is fine, we just keep losing that log.

title: Euro sign disappears from PDF invoices
description: Amounts on the invoice read "49.00" with an empty box where the € should be. Probably the font we embed does not include that glyph, HTML preview is fine.

title: Slow startup when plugin folder is large
description: With about 80 plugins the editor takes 45 seconds to open, as every manifest is parsed in sequence. Parallel loading or caching the results should help.

title: Pull requests from forks can read deploy key
description: Pipeline exposes deployment secrets to jobs from outside pull requests. An attacker could open a PR that prints them, a security hole in our CI.

title: Email can be changed without asking for password
description: An unlocked laptop for one minute is enough: change the mail, then reset the password. Sensitive account changes should ask for the current password again.

title: Reorder from history uses old price
description: Clicking reorder on a past purchase keeps the price from the past order in the cart. We lost money on about 60 orders before noticing, we want this fixed quickly.

title: Show remaining vacation days on the home screen
description: Employees always ask HR how many days they have left, and looking it up takes minutes each time. Please put the number on the landing page of the HR app.

title: FAQ on parking mentions wrong floor
description: Hospital FAQ page says parking is on level -2, it moved to level -1 after renovation. Outdated text like this in our visitor guide gets patients lost.

title: Copy last week's roster to this week
description: Most of our shifts repeat. Building the roster takes shift managers half an hour each Monday, so a single "copy from last week" action is what we are after.

title: Zigbee support on the second generation hub
description: Many customers already own Zigbee bulbs. Support for pairing them with the hub would make it much easier to sell the system to them.

title: Translate setup wizard help into French
description: Quebec customers get English help pages and an English setup guide in an otherwise French product. Could these 12 short help sections get translated? Text only, nothing else changes.

title: Option to hide my online status
description: I do not want everybody to see when I am online in the app. Please add an invisible setting, like many other chat programs have.

title: Display refresh burns battery on e-ink tag
description: Price tags refresh every 10 minutes even when nothing changed, and CPU wakeups take battery life from 5 years to 8 months. It should only wake up when price differs.

title: Printer queue stalls on receipts longer than one meter
description: Very long receipts stop the thermal printer halfway and every following receipt has to wait behind it, for minutes if nobody notices. Power cycling is the only way out at the moment.

title: Wish: choose start day of week
description: In our country the week starts on Saturday, but the calendar in the school portal always starts on Monday. Can it follow a setting? It would look more natural to the families.

title: In-app tutorial crashes on step 2
description: Tutorial screen crashes with NullPointerException on step 2 for new users. The instructions are fine, the step tries to read a profile that doesn't exist yet.

title: `grep` command in CLI takes minutes on big repos
description: Search subcommand opens every file, including binaries and vendored folders, and takes minutes. An ignore list and memory mapped reads would make it 10 times faster.

title: Please add a rate limit to the login endpoint
description: Nothing stops a script from trying thousands of passwords per minute on /login. We saw 90000 failed login attempts against one account last night, a lockout is needed.

title: Hospital parking code does not open gate
description: Booking mail gives me a parking code for my visit, and that gate says invalid every time. Reception gave me another code that worked, so your mail must be producing bad ones.

title: Customer addresses written to application logs
description: Info logs contain the whole delivery payload with names, phone numbers and addresses, kept for a year and exposed to anyone with log access. Privacy leak waiting to happen.

title: Option to pay rent by standing order in tenant app
description: As a tenant I want to set up monthly payment once and forget about it. Right now I must log in and press pay every month.

title: Group invite link says expired right after creation
description: i created an invite link, sent it, friend clicked it 10 seconds later and it says expired. tried three times with diffrent friends, always same.

title: GPA calculator on the transcript page
description: Students could enter expected grades for their current courses and see what GPA they would end up with. It is a very common question for advisors each term.

title: Let admins force a password change
description: At the start of each school year we would like to require all parents to choose a new password. Currently we can only ask them nicely by mail.

title: Totally wrong balance on my pension statement
description: Your statement for June shows my balance as if the May contribution never happened, but my employer confirmed they paid. Your phone line told me the screen "should be right". It is not.

title: Map shows my house in the sea
description: When I enter my address delivery map pin goes into middle of a sea and then says outside delivery area. I live in city center, this is ridiculous.

title: Memory card game for the kids app
description: My kids love matching games. A memory game in the learning app, with animal pictures, could also teach them the words. Nothing fancy, 12 cards are enough.

title: bluetooth pairing fails after firmware 1.9.2
description: band no longer pairs with phones paired before the update. forget device, pair again, it shows error 0x1F and disconnects. rolling back to 1.9.1 works.

title: Rounding error in split bill
description: Bug in split bill: 100.00 between three people gives 33.33 each and the remaining cent vanishes. The restaurant's till then shows a difference at closing every single day.

title: Thermostat reverts to 16 degrees after power cut
description: Firmware 2.4.0: the weekly schedule is lost when mains power comes back and the unit falls back to the factory setpoint. RTC battery measured fine.

title: Client decides its own score in leaderboard
description: Game posts the final score from the client with no validation, and a cheater with a modified account sits at 999999999 on the board. Basic security: server must not trust the client.

title: Dark theme for the admin console
description: Long sessions in the white admin console are hard on the eyes. Our night shift operators keep asking for an optional dark theme.

title: Parent portal shows wrong child after switching
description: Parents with two kids switch to a younger child and grades section keeps older child's list until reload. Name at top changes though, so it looks very confusing.

title: Duplicate rows after pressing save twice
description: Double click on Save creates two vendors, no idempotency check on POST /vendors.

title: Add --json output flag to CLI
description: Parsing the table output with awk is painful. Please add a `--json` flag on `list` and `status`, it makes scripting a lot easier for everyone using this in pipelines.

title: Class list visible to anyone with the link
description: Share link for a class list needs no login, and it has names and birth dates of minors. A parent forwarded it to a public group, so access has to be restricted.

title: Setup page outdated: asks for python 3.8
description: setup page in the wiki still says python 3.8 is enough, in reality you need 3.10 because of newer syntax. i spent an hour on odd syntax errors before finding out.

title: Mic stays muted after rejoining voice channel
description: If my connection drops and the app rejoins the room, my mic icon shows unmuted but nobody can hear me. Have to leave and enter again by hand.

title: Docker healthcheck kills container during migrations
description: The app answers 503 while migrations run, healthcheck counts that as failure and the orchestrator restarts it, which restarts the migration. An endless loop on first boot.

title: As a warehouse lead I want a pick route on the map
description: Pickers walk back and forth all day since the list is sorted by order line. If the app sorted items by shelf location and showed the route on a simple map, each trip gets shorter and the new people learn the layout faster.

title: Why does it log me off in the middle of typing
description: Writing a long reply in the parents forum and when I press send it says session ended and the text is gone. Third time this week, I gave up writing to the teacher.

title: Kids progress disappeared
description: My daughter finished 14 levels in the reading game and today it takes her back to level 1, her save does not load. We did not change anything on the tablet. How can this be restored?

title: Messages arrive out of order in group chat
description: In groups over about ten people, replies sometimes show above the message they answer. Closing and opening the app puts them back in order, so it looks like client side sorting.

title: Saved searches in the job portal
description: Let job seekers save a search and get a daily summary of new matches.

title: Wrong formula in the discount explanation
description: Pricing guide says discount is calculated after tax, with a worked example. System does it before tax and accounting confirmed that's correct, so this example needs redoing.

title: Search latency jumped after 3.4
description: p95 latency on /search went from 200 ms to 1.8 seconds with release 3.4.

title: Exam seat plan gives two students same seat
description: When the room has exactly 40 seats the plan gives seat 40 to two people, and on exam day they end up arguing at the door. It looks like an off by one somewhere, since rooms of other sizes look fine so far.

title: Parallel test workers share one database
description: With -n 4, workers truncate each other's tables and tests randomly fail with missing row errors. Each worker should get a schema of its own.

title: Encrypted search takes 20 seconds per query
description: Since patient names got encrypted at rest, a search decrypts the entire table in the app layer and takes 20 seconds. Encryption stays, a blind index would give us the speed back.

title: readme typo in env variable name
description: readme says DATABSE_URL, code reads DATABASE_URL. took me way too long to spot it. one letter fix in the docs.

title: Service container runs as root
description: API container runs as root with the Docker socket mounted, an attacker gets host access from one hole.

title: Session expired popup appears on the login page
description: Session expired popup shows on the login page itself, before anyone has logged in. Closing it is impossible on phones, the access button sits behind it.

title: Show password toggle on the sign in form
description: Older staff mistype long passwords and lock themselves out. An eye icon that reveals what you typed would be very welcome, like most apps have now.

title: TLS 1.0 still enabled on the payment host
description: Security scan lists TLS 1.0 and weak ciphers on the checkout host, so an attacker could read card data.

title: Hospital bed map shows a discharged patient
description: The ward screen keeps a discharged patient on bed 12 until midnight batch. New admissions cannot be assigned to that bed, and nurses call IT every evening.

title: Student can change own grade with a direct request
description: PUT /api/grades/55 succeeds with a student token, there is no access control on the server.

title: Documentation for student data export is missing
description: We tell schools they can get their data, but no documentation page says how or in what format. This guide should say so, we need something to send them.

title: Comments section vanishes on phones
description: On article pages the comments section is gone on phones since Tuesday, the counter still says 12 comments. Desktop is fine, so it looks like a broken media query.

title: Claim form loses attachments when you go back
description: I attached three photos and the supporting documentation for the damage, pressed back to fix the date, and all of it was gone without any warning. I am losing patience with this form.

title: Faster checkout option for returning customers
description: Add a one click reorder button for repeat buyers. It's not that the site is slow, it is that returning customers must go through all four steps every time.

title: SDK guide calls a method that no longer exists
description: Python example in the SDK guide uses client.getOrders(), which raises AttributeError because the method has been get_orders since 2.0. SDK is right, the docs need an update.

title: Parents guide has a dead login link
description: PDF guide we send out to parents has the old login address, which now goes to a parking page. Next printed letters go out in two weeks.

title: Good to have: compare two contract versions
description: Legal asked for a side by side view of two versions of a contract, showing what changed. Now they print both and use a highlighter.

title: Certificate expiry warning shows wrong date
description: Status page says cert expires 2025 while actual cert is valid through 2027. Date is parsed as day-first by a status widget, so warning text is simply incorrect and no action is needed.

title: Lockout can be used to block other people
description: Five wrong password attempts lock an account for a day. Knowing a username is enough to keep someone locked out forever, an abuse risk during exam week.

title: Add support for ARM runners
description: We are moving part of our fleet to ARM machines. The agent ships for x86 only. A build for arm64 would let us use the cheaper servers.

title: Refund answer in FAQ is out of date
description: FAQ page says refunds take up to 30 days, the policy changed to 14 days in January. Customers quote this outdated text to our agents.

title: Key rotation steps missing from ops guide
description: Ops guide tells you where the API keys live but not how to rotate them without downtime. That section should be written down with instructions and an example.

title: Order tracking stuck on Preparing
description: The restaurant confirmed that my food left 30 minutes ago, the app still says Preparing and the driver map does not load at all. This happens each time I order from here.

title: Nurse notes templates
description: Nurses type the same sentences again and again during a shift. Let the head nurse create short templates which can be inserted into a visit note with one click, and let each ward keep its own set, since their routines are quite different.

title: Slash commands in team chat
description: Proposal: typing /remind or /poll in a channel triggers a small action. This is what our power users keep asking for, and it could work through the existing bot API.

title: Student can't download own transcript
description: Looks like a bug: the button gives "Error 13: not authorised" for the student's own transcript if their name was changed last year. Registrar can download it for them, but that takes days.

title: Reading progress resets when font size changes
description: I change the font on my ebook and it takes me back to chapter 1, also the reading percentage goes to 0. Very annoying in the middle of a long novel.

title: Performance section of the docs is misleading
description: Docs brag that imports handle a million rows in under a minute. That number came from an empty database with no indexes. State the conditions or remove the claim from the page.

title: Payslip PDF shows last month's tax figure
description: Hello, several employees in our office received a March payslip with February's tax amount printed on it. The net pay on the same page is correct, so the numbers do not add up, and our accountant has to explain this to each of them.

title: Job queue unpickles data from the network
description: Workers call pickle.loads on whatever arrives, and the queue has no auth. Anyone who can access that port can run code on the worker, a remote code execution hole.

title: Help pages mix workspace and project
description: Half the help center says workspace, the other half project, for the same thing. App itself says project, so these docs pages need an update on that wording.

title: Zip bomb takes the import server down
description: A 40 KB zip that expands to 40 GB fills the disk and crashes the importer. Anyone with a free account can upload one, there's no limit on unpacked size.

title: Search finds nothing for words with a hyphen
description: Searching the catalogue for "t-shirt" returns zero results but "shirt" returns forty. Looks like the hyphen is dropped on the query side but kept in the index.

title: Can not change my phone number in profile
description: Account page says saved with a green check but after reload the old number is there. I tried with and without the country code. Same result on the website and in the app.

title: Geocoding each address one at a time
description: Route planning for 300 stops takes 5 minutes since each address is a separate HTTP call. Drivers wait every morning, a batch endpoint exists and is far faster.

title: Auto-archive finished projects
description: Add a setting that archives a project after 90 days with no activity.

title: Kiosk can be escaped to the desktop
description: Three finger swipe on the clinic check-in kiosk leaves the app and shows the desktop of the machine. From there I could open a browser and access the shared drive with patient letters, which is a security problem in a room full of strangers.

title: Booking page is very slow since last week
description: Hello, since last week the page for choosing a doctor takes a very long time to open, sometimes one minute. My internet is good and other sites load fast.

title: Tutorial mode for the first level
description: New players are lost in the first level and quit. Please add a tutorial mode with short hints, and a way to skip it for people who played before.

title: telnet left open on the camera
description: port 23 answers with root and no password, anyone on the network gets access.

title: Grade average ignores the course weights
description: Dashboard shows 72 average but with the weights in the syllabus it must be 78. My advisor calculated by hand too. I think the portal uses a simple mean.

title: static analysis takes longer than the tests
description: analysis takes 35 minutes for a one line change, this slow step blocks every merge.

title: Refund email says zero euro
description: Refund arrives fine but the confirmation mail says 0.00, so customers call us worried.

title: Guest checkout without an account
description: Many first time buyers leave when we ask them to create an account and password. Please let them order as a guest with only a mail address and login later if they like.

title: Sales tile shows 0 after its normal wait
description: Sales tile takes 30 seconds to load, that part is normal for us, and then it shows 0 instead of the real total. The query result is right, the widget maps the wrong column.

title: It's broken that reminders can't repeat
description: Well maybe not broken, but it feels that way. I want my medicine reminder every day and the app can only do it once. Please let reminders repeat.

title: Show bus occupancy on arrival board
description: Riders want to know if the next bus is full before it comes. We already get passenger counts from the door sensors, so the data exists.

title: Slow rendering of the seating chart
description: Seating chart for the big hall has 3000 seats, each an SVG group. Hover alone lags and the page needs 15 seconds to load, canvas rendering would be faster.

title: Add a replay button after each match
description: I want to watch my last round again after the match has ended. Even a short replay of 30 seconds is fun to share with friends.

title: Config path with tilde is not expanded
description: `--config ~/settings.yml` fails with file not found, expanduser call is missing in load_config().

title: Staff sign in through hospital identity provider
description: We would like nurses to log in with the hospital's existing SAML provider, so they have one less password to remember. IT can supply metadata when you are ready for it.

title: Map tiles downloaded again on every pan
description: fleet map downloads all tiles again on every pan, each pan takes seconds.

title: Reflected XSS in search parameter
description: /search?q=<script>alert(1)</script> executes on the results page, so sending someone a link can steal their session. Reported by a student, the security team should look at this host.

title: Onboarding checklist for new clinics is incomplete
description: Internal guide forgets the printer setup and the insurance codes, and it never says who is responsible for the first data import. Every new clinic discovers all that on day one, so update the document and say who does what in each section.

title: Train announcements in text form for deaf riders
description: Spoken platform changes reach some riders too late or never, and the display on the platform is often far away. A text alert in the app per train, with the new platform number, would make travel much better for deaf people.

title: Schedule heavy reports overnight
description: Some of our reports take a long time to run and that is fine, it is a lot of data. I would just like to schedule them for the night and find them in my inbox.

title: Document environment variables in one table
description: Config options are spread over five docs pages and some exist only in code. One table with name, default and purpose, please, next to the deployment guide.

title: Getting started video is three versions old
description: Video on our welcome page shows screens that no longer exist. Could be replaced by a short guide, or at least carry a note saying it is outdated.

title: Ability to mask patient names on the screen
description: Our waiting room has a display showing the queue, and we would like a setting that shows initials only. It is a wish from management, for now the screen simply shows what it was designed to show.

title: Attachment preview blank for HEIC photos
description: Photos from newer phones upload fine but the preview pane does not load and stays white, and download gives a zero byte file. JPEG attachments do not have this problem.

title: Docs search reflects script tags
description: Searching the docs site for a script tag runs it, the query is echoed without escaping. Docs share a cookie domain with the app, so this XSS exposes login sessions of customers.

title: Allow students to resubmit before deadline
description: At present one submission locks the assignment. Could teachers enable a setting so students may upload a corrected file until the deadline passes?

title: Your form says my postcode does not exist
description: I have lived here twenty years and your form insists the postcode is invalid. Cannot finish the registration at all. Other sites accept it without problem.

title: README quickstart fails because of a real bug in setup.py
description: I followed the guide word by word. The instructions are correct, but setup.py crashes on Python 3.12 since it imports a module that no longer exists. Not a doc problem, the code needs fixing.

title: Looking for a way to block a user in forum
description: Our students sometimes get unwanted messages from a certain person. There should be a block button so they stop seeing that account, moderators can't watch everything.

title: Bundle size grew to 6 MB of JavaScript
description: First load on mobile is slow, we ship 6 MB of JavaScript to everyone.

title: Two factor screen hidden behind keyboard
description: On small phones the six digit code field sits under the on-screen keyboard and the page does not scroll. People think the app has hung and give up on signing in.

title: Dashboard filter resets when switching tabs
description: region filter is gone every time i switch to the orders tab and back.

title: Server tick rate falls with 64 players
description: Tick rate falls from 60 to 22 at 64 players and latency climbs, CPU goes to inventory serialization under that load.

title: Copy a course from last semester
description: Teachers rebuild the same course page each term. A "copy from previous term" that can load the files and quizzes but not the students is a huge help.

title: Man page omits --exclude
description: `man tool-sync` has no --exclude section, though `--help` lists it since 1.4. Please update the man page docs.

title: Install guide still mentions Python 3.8
description: Setup instructions in the guide say Python 3.8 or later, but the project uses match statements and needs 3.10. People on old versions get syntax errors and think the code is bad.

title: Polls in group conversations
description: feature idea: we always ask "who is coming on friday" and then count replies by hand. a poll option in the group would be so much better, even a simple yes or no.

title: Docs: wrong order of steps for restoring a backup
description: Docs say start the service in step 3, restore in step 4, that corrupts data.

title: Table number printed wrong on kitchen ticket
description: Orders from table 12 print as table 1 on the kitchen printer, looks like only the first digit survives. Waiters carry food to the wrong people during dinner rush.

title: Write down how to run tests locally
description: Nothing about it in the readme. I guessed `make test`, which needs a database nobody told me about. A few lines of documentation help the next person.

title: Too many writes wearing the flash on sensors
description: Firmware writes logs to flash every second. Buffering in memory and writing every 10 minutes reduces CPU wakeups and gives flash the 5 year lifetime we promised.

title: Route map freezes when driver enters a tunnel
description: GPS signal drop leaves the map stuck and it does not load again until restart. Drivers have to pull over and relaunch the app, v6.0.3 on Android 12 tablets.

title: Bug: unread counter never goes down
description: This is not about speed or anything, chats load fine, but the red badge says 14 unread when I have read everything. Clearing notifications does not help on version 4.8.

title: Remember me cookie holds the password
description: remember_me cookie is just base64 of username and password, a serious security problem.

title: Video lessons buffer at the start of each class
description: At 8:00 sharp a thousand students load the same lesson, and our single origin can't keep up with that many requests. They watch a spinner for minutes and the teacher waits with them, so this really needs edge caching or staggered segments.

title: Cloud keys committed to the repository
description: Active access key sits in `deploy/settings.py`, secrets exposed to anyone with the repo.

title: Merge queue merges despite failing check
description: Queue uses the earlier passing result when a re-run fails, and merges anyway.

title: Broken anchor links in the FAQ
description: Clicking most questions at the top of the FAQ page goes nowhere, since anchors were renamed in the docs migration. Content is fine, the page just needs correct links.

title: I can't see my tickets anymore
description: I bought two tickets for the concert and the app said ok. Now "my tickets" is empty but the money is taken. The event is on Friday, please help quickly.

title: Token count in the usage screen is wrong
description: Our billing page shows twice the number of API tokens we actually used, since retries are counted again. Nothing to do with auth tokens, it is just the usage number for invoicing.

title: DELETE returns 200 but row is still there
description: Soft delete updates the wrong column after the rename, item stays visible in list calls.

title: Vulnerability disclosure page lists an old contact form
description: Security policy page sends people to a form that no longer exists. Not aware of any actual issue, the page text is just outdated.

title: CI test suite now takes 50 minutes
description: CI takes 50 minutes now, it was 12 a year ago, every test starts a fresh database.

title: Add a diagram for booking states to the wiki
description: New developers ask about the appointment lifecycle all the time. A state diagram on this wiki page explains allowed transitions better than a long section of docs.

title: Error message is useless when upload fails
description: It only says "Error occured" with no reason, whether a file is too big or its format is wrong. I would call this a defect since backend already returns a real reason and UI throws it away.

title: Ability to filter logs by request id in the admin UI
description: Support has to ask a developer to grep the logs every time. A simple search field for request id in the admin UI would let them answer many tickets alone.

title: Date range comparison in charts
description: We need to compare this quarter with the same quarter last year on one chart, with the second line dashed. Today we export two files and do it by hand.

title: Save products to look at later
description: Wishlist would be nice. I browse on my lunch break, see something for later, and then I can never find it again. Let me keep a list on my account.

title: Humidity reading stuck at 99.9
description: DHT driver returns 99.9 forever after one failed read, see sensor.c line 204.

title: Long GC pauses in the matching engine
description: 24 GB heap, GC pauses of 2 seconds or more delay every order in that window, latency is all over the place. Memory allocation rate looks too high.

title: Grade export chapter describes previous version
description: Teacher manual talks about a green Export button that moved under Actions two releases ago, and the list of options on that page has changed as well. This section and its screenshots are outdated, and teachers keep calling the helpdesk about it.

title: Read receipts per person in groups
description: Long press on a message should show who has read it. Our volunteer team needs to know if the shift change has been seen by all, without asking everyone.

title: MQTT traffic with passwords goes unencrypted
description: Gateways send device passwords over port 1883 in clear text, and anyone with a laptop on the same wifi can read them. Exposed credentials like this are a security risk.

title: Calendar shows bookings one hour off
description: Since last week the doctor's calendar displays every appointment one hour later than what the patient confirmed. The patient side looks correct. We have had double visits at reception.

title: Show allergy warnings on the menu
description: Our guests want to filter dishes by allergens in the ordering app. We have this information in the kitchen system, so it can maybe be connected.

title: Accessibility statement page dates from 2022
description: Statement page says "last reviewed 2022" and describes features we no longer have. We are required to keep this page current, someone should revise the text this term.

title: Multiplayer lobby shows wrong map after host change
description: When the host leaves, the new host's map choice is displayed but everyone loads the previous map. Causes instant desync and the match ends after a minute.

title: Security guard shift type in the roster
description: We run a night watch at the warehouse and the roster has no shift type for security guards. Please add one with its own hourly rate and a rule for night pay.

title: Missing license note in third-party list
description: About page and NOTICE file don't list two libraries we added in spring. Legal asked to keep this document complete, so the page needs an update.

title: Real estate map pins vanish after zoom
description: Zoom in past level 14 and listing pins no longer load, zooming out brings them back. Browser console shows a tile request with a negative coordinate.

title: Docs for the MQTT topics are incomplete
description: Device topics for humidity and door modules aren't listed in the integration docs. I found them by sniffing the broker. Could the guide list all topics with an example payload?

title: Optional two factor login with authenticator app
description: Larger clients keep asking about this in their procurement forms. Could it be added as an opt-in setting under profile? We do not need it to be mandatory yet.

title: Readme generator in the project wizard
description: When someone creates a new project the wizard could fill in a readme with the project name and install steps. Today most new projects have an empty one.

title: Docker build takes 25 minutes without layer reuse
description: Copying the whole repo before installing dependencies breaks the cache on any file change, so each build is slow. Reordering the Dockerfile cuts most builds to two minutes.

title: Export locks the table for other users
description: Customer export takes 5 minutes in one long transaction and other users wait the whole time. Query should read from the replica, this hits everyone.

title: Rate limit headers are not documented
description: No docs page mentions X-RateLimit-Remaining or X-RateLimit-Reset, please add a short note.

title: No limit on one time code attempts
description: 4 digit login code with unlimited tries, an attacker gets through it in minutes.

title: Revenue chart double counts refunds
description: refunded orders are subtracted twice on the monthly dashboard, april looks 6 percent too low.

title: Wrong index makes the search crawl
description: Planner picks the index on created_at over the tenant id, and a search takes 25 seconds for big tenants. Results are right with no error, just too long a wait.

title: Sensor graph draws a straight line during outage
description: When a soil probe goes offline the chart connects the last two points as if nothing happened. We want a gap there, right now farmers trust numbers that never existed.

title: Password reset link goes to a 404 page
description: Link in reset mail opens a not found page since yesterday's release. Token in URL looks fine, that route itself seems to be gone.

title: Self hosted runner keeps old env var
description: Rotated pipeline values stay old until the runner restarts, env is cached per process.

title: Outdated screenshots in the savings app guide
description: Printed guide for our savings app shows a login screen from two versions back. Elderly customers phone us because the picture differs from their phone, so this manual needs an update.

title: Mesh nodes flood network with status messages
description: Every node rebroadcasts status each 2 seconds. With 60 nodes commands to the lights wait up to 8 seconds in the air, it needs rate limiting per node to reduce latency.

title: School portal crawling during exam registration
description: When registration opens the portal gets so slow that students miss preferred slots. Pages take minutes to load, I guess the server can't handle this load.

title: Change email form has no CSRF protection
description: Any site can auto-submit a POST to /account/email. If the victim is logged in their mail is changed, and the attacker can then reset the password and take the account.

title: Threat model page in the wiki is outdated
description: Threat model page lists only the attacker types we considered in 2021. No actual flaw to report here, the document just needs a review and an update.

title: Radio wakes every 5 seconds and drains the battery
description: Sensor node should last 6 months but is flat in 2 weeks. Trace shows the radio waking every 5 seconds, so CPU never sleeps, which is far too much load for a keepalive nobody needs.

title: CLI help lists a flag that was removed
description: `tool --help` still shows `--legacy-auth`, and using it gives an unknown option error. Flag is meant to be gone, so help text and docs reference page should stop mentioning it.

title: Explain retry behaviour in webhook guide
description: Webhook guide never explains how many times we retry a failed delivery, how long we wait between attempts, or what happens after the last one. Partners keep asking support the same thing, and one short section with a table does the job.

title: Order page hangs forever when I use a discount code
description: I typed my discount code and clicked apply, then the wheel just keeps turning and I can't pay. I waited 10 minutes. Without the code I can pay ok, but then I lose the discount.

title: Remappable controller buttons
description: I play with an adapted controller and the fixed layout does not work for me. Please let players assign each action to any button, it would make the game accessible to many more people.

title: Waiting list patient gets two confirmation letters
description: When a slot opens and reception moves a patient off the waiting list, the system sends two confirmations with different times. One time is simply wrong and people show up early.

title: anyone can see other users orders
description: changed the number in /orders/5521 and got access to somebody elses order with their adress on it. please fix this quickly, its private data.

title: Goalkeeper walks through the post
description: in penalty mode the keeper clips through the left post and gets stuck inside it.

title: Stock list very slow to open with thousands of SKUs
description: Stock screen has become really slow now that we are past 40000 products, about 20 seconds every time. Can it load only what is on screen?

title: Schedule a heating program per room
description: Currently the schedule applies to the entire house. We have a home office that only needs heat on weekdays, so please consider a per-room program in a future firmware.

title: API key passed in query string ends up in logs
description: Partners send `?api_key=FAKE-KEY-0000` on each call and the full URL lands in proxy logs a whole support team can read. Secrets exposed in logs, move it to a header.

title: Checkout stuck on spinner after applying voucher
description: Enter a voucher code on payment step, press apply, and a spinner turns forever. No error in UI, network tab shows that call returned 422 and frontend never handles it.

title: Slow motion button for game replays
description: I want a slow motion button in the replay screen, quarter speed is enough. It is for checking close finishes with friends, the game itself runs great.

title: Build fails on Linux runners: case sensitive import
description: Test file imports ./UserCard while the file is named userCard.tsx. Passes on dev laptops, explodes on the Linux runner with Cannot find module.

title: Auto-save drafts so a crash does not cost me my text
description: If the browser crashes or the tab closes, my half written report is gone. I would like a draft saved every minute, as most editors do now.

title: Add progress bar for long exports
description: Big exports take minutes and nothing moves on screen, so people click again and again. We do not expect it to run faster, we just want to see how far along it is.

title: Dynamic QR codes on event badges
description: We are planning a conference and want each badge to open the visitor's schedule when scanned. Is it possible to include such a code in the badge export?

title: Kindly provide option for downloading statement by year
description: At present I am able to download only month by month, and for income tax I must do this twelve times and then join the files myself. Kindly give one button for the full year, it will be very helpful for all customers.

title: Shaders compile during gameplay
description: Big hitches the first time you see each effect, because shaders compile on demand and that takes seconds. Precompiling makes the game load longer once and then run smooth.

title: Student handbook has wrong library hours
description: Online student guide says library closes at 22:00, it closes at 20:00 since September. Some students found closed doors, this page needs an update.

title: Terrible that I must re-enter my card every time
description: Every single order I type all sixteen digits again, what is this, 2005? Let me store a card like every other shop does, or I am going elsewhere.

title: Particle effects tank frame rate on mobile
description: Smoke in the final boss arena takes the game from 30 to 9 FPS on mid-range phones. Fewer particles on low settings would reduce the CPU load.

title: Connection pool exhausted in peak hour
description: Between 11:30 and 13:00 the ordering API runs out of database connections and requests wait 10 seconds or more. Long transactions hold their connections during payment calls, so when the provider is slow our whole lunch rush gets slow with it.

title: Peer review for student essays
description: I am teaching a writing course, and students should be able to anonymously review two essays from classmates before the deadline. Could this be built into the assignment tool?

title: Admin cannot unlock locked accounts
description: The unlock button on the admin screen returns 500 with a SQL error about a missing column. Users stay locked until someone runs an update by hand. Broken since the migration on Monday.

title: Stop making me type my city, this is so slow
description: Your form asks for city and postcode each time. If the app filled in the city from the postcode, it would save seconds on every order. The form works, it's just tedious.

title: New lines in username forge log entries
description: A username with %0a is written as is, so anyone can add fake lines to the login audit log. Log injection, a security problem, encode control characters.

title: Possibility to add second parent to student account
description: For the moment only one parent login per child. Many families need both parents to see grades and absence, so please allow adding a second one.

title: Authentication page says tokens last 24 hours
description: Auth page in the developer docs says access tokens live 24 hours. Since v3 they live 1 hour. The token behaviour is intended, only the docs need updating.

title: SMS reminder sent at 3am
description: Patients got appointment reminders in the middle of the night because this job uses server clock and not clinic time zone. We received angry calls next morning.

title: Admin guide does not explain roles
description: What can a Manager do that an Editor can't? Role table in the admin guide stops at version 2 with no row for new roles. No access problem, we just need the page updated for onboarding.

title: Documentation hard to find from inside the app
description: I am told everything is described somewhere but I can't find it. Is there an index page for docs topics? Documentation site has only a search box and a few articles, this could be organized better.

title: Webhook fired three times for one payment
description: Retry wrapper resends even when the receiver answered 200, because we check for `status == "ok"` and the response has `"OK"`. Customers get triple emails.

title: One page guide needed for the new grade book
description: New grade book went live and nobody has seen any instructions. A short guide with the five things teachers do most would stop the panic in the staff room.

title: Path traversal in archive extract command
description: `tool unpack` follows ../ entries in a zip and writes outside the target folder. A malicious archive can overwrite a user's shell startup file, a real security vulnerability.

title: You charged me in dollars not in euros
description: The price on the product page is in euros, at the end the card statement says dollars, and with bank fees it is more than I agreed. Something is not right in your checkout.

title: Login message reveals whether an account exists
description: Wrong mail gives "no such user", right mail with bad password gives "wrong password". An attacker can collect valid accounts from this, a small security leak.

title: TLS chapter tells readers to switch off certificate checks
description: Setup guide says "set verify=false if you get a certificate error" with no warning at all. People copy that into production. The chapter should explain the proper fix with a trusted CA.

title: Cancel button actually confirms order
description: I pressed Cancel on a popup and my order went through anyway!! Had to call your shop. On mobile site those two buttons seem to be mixed up.

title: Your feature for splitting payments charges full price
description: The new split payment feature took the whole amount from my card rather than half. My friend was charged her half too, so you got 150 percent of the bill. Please refund and repair it.

title: Nightly job runs twice on the day clocks change
description: The cron trigger in local time fires twice in October, and the second run overwrites good reports with partial ones. UTC schedule would avoid it.

title: Session count on admin dashboard is doubled
description: The "active sessions" tile shows about twice the real number. Each browser tab refreshes the counter with a new row, and the query does not group by user.

title: Monday morning rush makes the site unusable
description: Every Monday at 9 all staff clock in, and response time goes from 300 ms to 20 seconds. Nothing fails with an error, people simply wait and wait.

title: ValueError on decimal quantities in stock endpoint
description: POST /stock with quantity 1.5 gives ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10 and a 500 response. Should either accept it or return a clear 422.

title: Delivery driver sees cancelled orders
description: Orders cancelled by customers stay on a driver's list for up to an hour, list does not load new status. Two drivers went to a restaurant for nothing yesterday.

title: Sprite flickers during cutscene on level 9
description: The main character flickers between two animation frames for the whole cutscene. Only on the Vulkan renderer, OpenGL looks ok. Build 0.9.4-beta.

title: Reset token never expires
description: Password reset link from four months ago still worked today, so anyone with an old mail gets access to my account. Tokens must expire.

title: XML import resolves external entities
description: Invoice XML upload parses external entities, so anyone with a malicious file can read /etc/passwd from the server. XXE vulnerability, verified in test with a harmless path.

title: Load more button on order history
description: My order history stops at the newest 20 orders and there is no way to go further back. A load more button at the bottom is all that I am asking for.

title: `explain` command for error codes
description: Would be handy to run `tool explain E1042` and read what that error means right in the terminal. Now I have to open the website every time and search.

title: Newsletter preview differs from what gets sent
description: Preview shows right images, while sent mail has an old header section from last month. Some store of rendered template is not being cleared.

title: Very upset: my order vanished after paying
description: Money left my account on Tuesday and the order is nowhere in my history. Your chat bot keeps telling me to check my history. I want it found or I want my money back.

title: Museum audio guide plays wrong room
description: Beacon in room 5 triggers the commentary for room 15, I think the id is parsed as text and cut. Visitors look confused and keep asking the staff.

title: Would be nice if passwords were not stored in plain text
description: Your support agent read my password out to me on the phone, so I guess you can see every account password. That really worries me, please store them properly.

title: vaccination reminder sent for wrong pet
description: our vet clinic system sends the reminder with the name of the owner's other animal if they have more than one. people find it funny but it should be correct.

title: Tuning guide refers to a removed setting
description: Performance tuning guide tells admins to raise `cache_mb`, which was dropped in 5.0. Update the page to describe `cache_size` and its new default.

title: Survey skip logic shows hidden question
description: Answer No to question 3, and question 4 in that section should be hidden. It is hidden on desktop, but on phones it still shows and blocks submit because it is required.

title: Deleted messages still come back from the API
description: Deleted chat messages vanish in the app, but GET /messages still returns the text with a flag set. Anyone with an account can read them through the API, a privacy problem.

title: Router admin page shows wrong connected device count
description: Admin page says 3 devices when 9 are connected, and a refresh changes it randomly. No effect on the network itself, only the number is off. Router firmware 7.11.

title: Help link in settings goes to wrong article
description: That "How billing works" link in settings takes you to an article about changing your avatar. Either link or article id was mapped wrong when our help center moved.

title: Add pagination to /v1/shipments
description: Partners with large accounts ask for cursor based pagination on this endpoint.

title: Generate a printable manual from the help pages
description: Some customers want the help content on paper for their workshop. A button which bundles all the help articles into a single PDF would solve that, and we would not need to keep a second copy.

title: Performance tab of dashboard shows data for wrong month
description: Not speed related, it is a team performance page in our HR tool. Picking March shows February ratings, query uses month minus one on first of each month.

title: Student photo shows on wrong student card
description: After bulk upload of photos a few cards have the neighbour's photo, the mapping seems shifted by one when a file name is missing from the batch.

title: Camera stream open on the local network
description: RTSP stream of the baby monitor plays with no password for anyone on the wifi, including guests. Nasty privacy and security surprise for parents.

title: CPU usage widget always says 100 percent
description: Device status page shows 100 percent CPU for every gateway no matter the load, the value is divided by the wrong core count after the 2.6 firmware.

title: Fail: no export for my own data
description: I wanted to take my training history to a new coach and found no export anywhere. It is my data, and I think an export button is the minimum you can offer.

title: Annoying popup every time, let me turn it off
description: The rating popup comes each time I open the app, and I am tired of closing it. There is no setting for this at all. Please give me a way to switch it off for good.

title: your manual is wrong and cost me a day
description: I followed your thermostat manual exactly, page 9 says red wire goes to terminal 2. Installer told me it's terminal 1 on this model. Please correct the manual before someone breaks their heating.

title: Help article on exports describes a menu I do not have
description: Your help page "How to export" says to click Tools, then Export, and I have no Tools menu. Maybe the instructions are outdated, in which case it should say so at the top.

title: Password check on bulk import takes hours
description: Importing 50000 users runs the full password hash on each row, one by one, and takes 11 hours at full CPU. It could run in parallel.

title: Saved games gone on my second phone
description: I log in on the new phone with same account and it can only load the save from 3 months ago. Cloud sync says "up to date", which is clearly not true. I lost weeks of play.

title: Allow split shifts in roster
description: Roster takes one block per day, we need a second block for split shifts.

title: Slow network makes pay button charge twice
description: On a slow 3G connection the pay button stays active after the first tap, so impatient customers tap again and get two orders. Both charges are real, we refunded four people this week.

title: Deeply nested JSON hangs the API
description: Posting JSON nested 100000 levels eats all memory and the process restarts. No login needed for this endpoint, so an attacker can keep us down with a one line script.

title: Shell completion for bash and zsh
description: Tab completion for subcommands and flags please, happy to send a pull request.

title: Editing the address bar number opens someone else's appointment
description: Dear clinic, when I change the number at the end of the web address after login I get appointment details of other people. I closed it right away, but I should not have this access.

title: Docstring of parse_date lies about return type
description: Docs for this function say it returns str, while it returns a date object. Trivial fix on the docs page, and parse_time right below it has the same outdated docstring.

title: Pomodoro timer skips break when phone is locked
description: when my phone is locked, timer jumps straight over my 5 minute break into next work block. only happens if screen is off at that moment.

title: My salary slip is not downloading
description: Dear team, I click download on the salary slip and it gives a file of 0 KB which is not opening. My colleagues have same issue since 25 of the month. Kindly resolve soon.

title: Search by symptom in the clinic app
description: Patients don't know which department they need. A small symptom guide, where they type "knee pain" and get suggested departments, would mean fewer wrong bookings.

title: site so slow on sale days
description: on black friday your shop was almost dead, each page took 30 seconds or more to load. i gave up and bought somewhere else.

title: Slower page loads after adding the chat widget
description: Page speed audit dropped 30 points, pages now take 3 seconds more. Widget has to load 1.2 MB before anything is interactive. Could we defer it until first scroll?

title: Virus scan badge stuck on Pending
description: Files finished scanning hours ago but badge in document list still says pending. Scanner logged clean for each one, frontend just never polls again, so staff keep uploading same files.

title: KeyError when config has no region section
description: KeyError: 'region' at settings.py line 33 on any install without the optional block. README says the section is optional, and it should be, the code just does not guard it.

title: So annoying, no bulk delete in my photos
description: I must delete 300 photos one at a time, with a confirm popup for each. Absolutely mad. Give us a select mode, the gallery works fine otherwise.

title: API tokens with an expiry date
description: When I generate a token in the portal it lasts forever by design. Our security lead would like a date picker, so a token for a one-week contractor just stops on its own.

title: let players trade items
description: please give us a trading window between friends. i have 40 spare swords and my friend needs one. no real money, just items.

title: Let the attacker aim in penalty mode
description: As attacker in penalty mode I want to choose where to aim the shot, right now it is random. A small arrow to steer it makes the game so much more fun.

title: Quickstart guide still uses the old port
description: Getting started guide says to open localhost:8080, but the service moved to 9090 a year ago. New hires lose an hour on this, please update the page.

title: GET /api/v3/orders ignores status filter
