description: `?status=shipped` returns every order regardless of status. Query param is read as `state` in controller since rename in 3.2, so filter silently does nothing.

title: Token validation calls auth server on every request
description: Each API call has to wait 300 ms for a remote token check, even for a token validated seconds ago. A short lived cache could cut average latency in half.

title: Add a "mark all as read" button
description: i get 200 notifications from my course groups and there is no way to clear them at once. pressing them one by one takes minutes. thanks.

title: Add index or something, this table is unusable
description: Sorting shipments by date takes half a minute with our volume. My colleague says an index makes this query fast, can you look at it?

title: Update command downgrades to older release
description: Bug in version compare: `selfupdate` treats versions as strings, so 1.9.0 counts as newer than 1.10.0. It happily installs the older binary and reports success.

title: CSV parser spends most of its time in regex
description: Importing a 500 MB file takes 11 minutes, 9 of those in a regex per field. Slow and wasteful, the standard csv module should take under one.

title: Kafka consumer skips a message after rebalance
description: Offsets get committed before processing, so a rebalance in the middle of a batch loses one event without any trace in the logs. We reconciled 37 missing shipment updates by hand last month, and the customers noticed most of them before we did.

title: Backup encryption pins all CPU cores
description: From 01:00 to 04:00 the encryption job uses every CPU core, so night shift reports are very slow. Could it run at lower priority or on fewer threads?

title: Session cookie lacks HttpOnly and Secure flags
description: Security scan flagged our session cookie: no HttpOnly, no Secure, no SameSite.

title: Product page is 14 MB because of huge images
description: Pictures are uploaded at 6000 px and served as they are, so the page takes 25 seconds to load on phones. Far too slow, resize on upload.

title: Why on earth can't I sort by date
description: This is ridiculous, in 2026 a bookings table with no sort option. I scroll through hundreds of rows every morning to find the newest. Please add sortable columns.

title: Role dropdown snaps back to Viewer
description: Choosing Editor in team settings looks fine until you save, then the dropdown shows Viewer again. The API call really does send Viewer, so the frontend state is off by one option.

title: We need approval step before publishing a course
description: At the moment any teacher can publish directly. Our quality office wants to review a course first, so a "submit for approval" step would suit our process.

title: Answer key downloadable before exam
description: Exam module stores the answer key next to the question PDF, and anyone can guess the URL and get access by changing the file name. A student told me this morning, the exam is tomorrow and I don't know who else has seen it.

title: API docs show a real looking key in examples
description: All samples on the docs page use a long random string as api key, and beginners ask if it is shared. Replace with `YOUR_KEY_HERE` for clarity, the value was never valid.

title: Version switcher on the API reference site
description: We still run 2.x in production but the docs site only displays 3.x. A dropdown for choosing which version you are reading would be appreciated, the old text already exists in the repo.

title: Emoji in display name breaks the member list
description: Funny bug. Someone in our study group put a cactus emoji in their display name and now the member list only loads up to that person.

title: cant book appointment on last day of month
description: when i pick the 31st the calendar jumps to next month and the slot i choosed is gone. tried on phone and on laptop, same thing.

title: Can you make the app work on smart watches
description: I'd like to see my next bus on my watch without taking out the phone. A very simple screen would be enough, just the line and the minutes.

title: Logout does not end the session on the server
description: Security issue: after logging out, the old session cookie still works when replayed with curl an hour later. Anyone holding that cookie keeps access to the account.

title: Choose minutes of inactivity before logout
description: Please add a setting for how many minutes of inactivity pass before logout. Our kiosks need 2 minutes, office staff want 60, and today it is one value for everyone.

title: App is not save my address, always empty
description: Every time I am ordering I must write again my address because the saved one is not showing. I have add it three times in profile and it says succesful.

title: It is slowly opening the invoices page
description: Invoices page is opening very slowly, it takes about one minute to load, since we are having more than 10000 invoices. Before it was good. Please check performance.

title: Webhook signature check fails for bodies with non ASCII
description: Our verifier re-encodes the payload as latin-1 before hashing, so any body with an accented character is rejected as invalid. Legit partner events get dropped with a 400.

title: Backup job reports success with no file
description: Nightly backup log says OK but the target folder has nothing since 12 June, because the mount failed and the script wrote to a temp dir. Found this when we needed a restore.

title: Message delivery delayed by minutes at night
description: Between 20:00 and 23:00 messages take up to 3 minutes to reach the other person, people just wait. Queue depth climbs, we probably need more consumers to handle the load.

title: Renew all skips the last book
description: In the library app "renew all" renews everything except the bottom item in the list. I got an overdue notice because of it, twice now.

title: Allow PDF upload in the prescription form
description: The form takes only JPG and PNG. Most doctors here send a PDF as documentation, so patients need to convert it first. Can you accept PDF as well?

title: The reports are taking too much time
description: When we are opening the monthly report it is taking more than 10 minutes and all users must wait. Before upgrade it was only taking few seconds.

title: We want to see stock across all branches
description: When a customer asks in shop A, the cashier can only see the stock of shop A. Showing the other branches would let us send people to the right place instead of losing the sale.

title: MQTT reconnect uses stale client id
description: After network loss device reconnects with same id while broker still holds old session, broker kicks it and it reconnects again. Log is full of this loop.

title: Sample config on setup page has YAML error
description: Copying sample.yml from the setup guide gives "mapping values are not allowed here" on line 9. Program is fine with a correct file, only the sample on that page is broken.

title: Sync re-hashes every file on each run
description: `sync` on a 300 GB folder takes 20 minutes hashing files that did not change. Comparing size and mtime first should make it far faster.

title: Copy button on code samples in developer portal
description: Selecting long curl commands by hand is awkward and people miss a character. A small copy icon in the corner of each sample would be a nice touch on the docs site.

title: Wiki page for each student club
description: Student clubs want a simple wiki page in the portal for their group, with events and photos. Today they use many outside sites that nobody can find.

title: Parents should get a message when kid is absent
description: As parent I want automatic message with the absence documentation if my child is marked absent in the first lesson. Now we find out only in the evening or never.

title: As a parent, let me pay school fees in the app
description: We now bring cash in an envelope or make a bank transfer with a long reference. A pay button in the parent app is what we would really want.

title: Oversized packet crashes thermostat from anywhere on the LAN
description: A UDP packet over 1500 bytes on port 5683 crashes the parser and reboots the unit with no login needed. Looks like a stack overflow, a vulnerability an attacker could exploit.

title: Password rules text contradicts checker
description: Screen says 8 characters is enough, then checker refuses my 8 character password with "too short". Trying 10 works. So either check or sentence has a mistake in code.

title: Bug? Phone gets hot and battery drops with your app
description: Your app in the background makes my phone warm and takes 30 percent battery overnight, with CPU busy all the time. Battery settings blame your app, it's polling something I guess.

title: Can't type a hyphen in my last name
description: Registration form says invalid characters when my last name has a hyphen in it.

title: Invoice language should follow the customer
description: Our French customers would like invoices in French while we work in English. Please allow us to choose the invoice language per customer record.

title: autocomplete fires a request on every keystroke
description: 12 letters typed means 12 api queries, a debounce should reduce this load.

title: Add MFA reset to the helpdesk tools
description: When somebody loses a phone our helpdesk has no button to reset their second factor, so we file a ticket with the vendor. Our security team agrees, can the helpdesk role get that action?

title: Pay with installments option in checkout
description: Could you add an option to pay big orders over three months? Several of our furniture customers have asked and two left when they found out it is not possible.

title: Clock drifts 4 minutes per day on feeder
description: Pet feeder never resyncs after the first NTP call, so meals come later and later.

title: Thread pool starvation under load
description: At 200 concurrent requests latency goes vertical, blocking mail calls occupy all workers.

title: Export endpoint has no authorization check
description: Normal account can download the full customer list from /admin/export/customers, no access check at all.

title: Welcome feature tour popup will not close
description: New users get the setup guide popup and the X button does nothing on small screens. They are stuck behind the overlay and cannot reach the app at all.

title: Bookmark pages in textbook reader
description: students need to mark pages in their study guide they will come back to before the exam. a small bookmark icon and a list would be enough for us.

title: Decimal comma breaks salary import
description: German payroll file uses 1.234,56 and the importer reads it as 1.234 so people's salaries look like one euro. Thank goodness the review screen caught it.

title: Appointment reminders stopped for my account
description: I used to get a text one day before each visit, then they just stopped in spring. I missed a visit and got charged. I checked, notifications are switched on.

title: Warehouse app feels sluggish after new version
description: Scanning an item used to respond immediately, now there is a wait of two seconds after every scan. Over a shift of about two thousand scans this slow response adds up to more than an hour of lost time per person.

title: Grade book freezes while 600 students load
description: Opening the grade book for a big course takes 20 seconds and locks the browser tab. Every cell is a heavy component, virtual scrolling helps with this load.

title: Please correct the example in the manual
description: In your manual page 14 the example is not correct, it is saying use port 21 but in the new version is port 22. Please to update this section.

title: Typing indicator stuck after other person leaves
description: "is typing..." stays forever if the other side closes the app mid sentence.

title: Let anyone in the team edit the shared calendar
description: Today only the creator of a shared calendar can change it. Our team wants anyone with access to the calendar to add or move entries without asking for rights.
